quests.name: First Steps
quests.lead: First Steps is a primary quest that teaches you the basics of the game before introducing you to the narrative. It is recommended for first-time players to not skip through these quests and jump into Dragon Slayer so that they can fully understand the mechanics of the game.
quests.desc: Begin your adventure.
quests.start: Speak to the Wise Old Man in the Temple, in Temple Woods.
quests.walkthrough:
Begin your adventure!

Go and speak to the Wise Old Man in the temple. He will tell you about the dragon and offer to teach you about the basics, which you can either accept or refuse. If you refuse it, you can talk with him again in Bramblemead Village to finish the quest. If you accept the tutorial, he will send you to Doric just outside the temple, starting Getting Started.

Before Setting Off...

This step is covered, in more detail, through the following quest articles: Getting Started, Ratcatcher, and Rune Mysteries.

Doric will teach you how to make processing stations, introduce to you the building system, and then send you off to Vannaka. The slayer master will send you to fight off nearby rats, teach you how to cook your food, and help you know which way the pointy end goes before sending you to Zanik. When you talk to Zanik, she will help you learn the magic system, crafting runes for spells, and even unlock a spell or two. When she has taught you everything, she'll then send you off to the Wise Old Man.

Finishing up...

After completing the above section, or if you skipped the tutorial, go to Bramblemead Village and find the Wise Old Man on the first floor of a ruined building at the far end of the village. Talk to him to learn about the next step in your adventure.

Congratulations. Quest complete!
quests.rewards: • 1 Tome of Runecrafting - Vol 1
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Getting Started
  • Ratcatcher
  • Rune Mysteries
  • Dragon Slayer

quests.name: Getting Started
quests.lead: Getting Started is the second primary and tutorial quest. It will teach you about hydration, sustenance, and crafting.
quests.desc: Doric wants to teach you some survival basics.
quests.start: Speak to Doric outside of the Temple.
quests.req: First Steps
quests.item_req:
• 1 dirty water
  • 10 ash logs
  • 8 stones
quests.walkthrough:
Doric wants to teach you some survival basics

To start the quest, the player must accept to learn the basics in the First Steps quest.

After you accept it, go and talk to Doric just outside the temple. He will teach you about the importance of sustenance (food) and hydration (drink). He will send you to get some water (and maybe some redberries on the way). Go south or north to the pond, go into the water, and get at least one dirty water (default hotkey: E). Go back to Doric, who will tell you that you need to boil the water, otherwise it will have side effects (you will be poisoned, it is implied, by Soulscourge if you drink too much dirty water). Then he will tell you that you need to craft a stone club.

Gather at least one ash log or stone to open the building menu, from where you can build the crafting table. You need to gather 4 ash logs to make the crafting table, and an additional 6 ash logs and 8 stone to craft the stone club. The logs can be found lying around the trees, and stones can be found lying around the ruins of the temple. Speak to Doric when you have the club. He will send you to Vannaka to learn to fight, starting Ratcatcher.

Congratulations. Quest complete!
quests.rewards: • 1 vegetable soup
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Ratcatcher
objectives: Collect some dirty water from the nearby ponds and bring them back to Doric.
Build a crafting table and craft a stone club, then bring it to Doric.
Bring the stone club to Doric outside the temple.

quests.name: Ratcatcher
quests.lead: Ratcatcher is the third primary quest where you can learn about fighting and cooking.
quests.desc: Vannaka wants to teach you the basics of hunting, fighting and cooking.
quests.start: Speak to Vannaka south of the Windmill.
quests.req: Getting Started
quests.item_req:
• 4 raw rat meat
  • 6 ash logs
  • 4 stones
quests.walkthrough:
Go and talk to Vannaka, who is directly north-east of Doric, south of the windmill. He will tell you that you need food to be able to keep fighting, so you need to get some rat meat.

Go to the north up to the windmill, and kill 4 giant rats to get 4 raw rat meats. Gather 4 ash logs and 4 stones to build a campfire, and some more logs to fuel it. Cook the meat on the campfire to get 2 rat roasts.

Bring the rat roasts back to Vannaka. He will send you to Zanik to learn about magic, starting Rune Mysteries.

Congratulations. Quest complete!
quests.rewards:
• 1 stone logging axe
  • 1 stone dagger
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Rune Mysteries
objectives: Speak to Vannaka near the Windmill.
Kill rats and successfully cook one rat roast from their meat.
Speak to Vannaka.
Bring 3 small animal fangs to Vannaka

quests.name: Rune Mysteries
quests.lead: Rune Mysteries is the fourth primary quest where Zanik will teach you about runecrafting and magic.
quests.desc: Zanik wants you to learn the basics of crafting runes.
quests.start: Speak to Zanik east of Vannaka.
quests.req: Ratcatcher
quests.item_req:
• 50 ash logs
  • 12 stones
  • 10 rune essences
quests.walkthrough:
Zanik wants you to learn the basics of crafting runes

Go east from Vannaka to the road to reach Zanik and speak to her.

She will tell you about magic and send you to gather some logs. Gather 50 ash logs, then talk to her again.

Rune crafting

Zanik will tell you about the Axtral Projection and how you can create runes. You'll get a stone pickaxe, with that, mine some rune essence from the rune essence geysers. You can mine the rocks on the ground around the geysers by using either ranged or magic weapons to strike them down. Gather 12 stones and 4 rune essence and build a rune altar, which can be found in the Building menu, under the Crafting tab.

Next, craft some air runes and astral runes.

Go back to Zanik and talk with her. She will send you to the Wise Old Man to start the Warding Off Danger quest.

Congratulations, quest complete!
quests.rewards:
• 1 stone pickaxe
  • 50 air rune
  • 50 astral rune
  • 1 Tome of Woodcutting - Vol 1.
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • First Steps
objectives: Speak to Zanik, near the river down the road from the temple.
Bring 50 ash logs to Zanik.
Speak to Zanik near the river, down the road from the temple.
Mine Rune Essence, craft some Air and Astral Runes by building a Rune Altar or from Siphoning Anima Vents.
Return to Zanik.
Speak to the Wise Old Man in the temple.
Mine rune essence, build a rune altar and craft some air runes.
Speak to the Wise Old Man in the temple.

quests.name: Growing Pains
quests.lead: Growing Pains is a secondary quest that is meant to teach the player how to use the Farming skill.
quests.desc: Learn the basics of the Farming skill from the Wise Old Man.
quests.start: Create the wooden watering can or the wooden spade in the crafting table interface.
quests.req: None
quests.item_req:
• 18 ash logs to build an ash farming plot, wooden spade, and a wooden watering can
  • 2 coarse thread to build the Wooden Spade and Wooden Watering Can
  • 3 wheat seeds (acquired during quest)
quests.rec: • Building an ash farming plot near a pond
quests.enemies: None
quests.walkthrough:
Make and receive either the wooden watering can or the wooden spade in your inventory. This will trigger a quest to start talking to the Wise Old Man at Bramblemead Valley, where he will give you the basics of the Farming skill. Ensure that at least one inventory space is available to receive the wheat seeds.

Building a plot

After talking to the Wise Old Man, create an ash farming plot and dig the plot whilst wielding the wooden spade. Dig five times, and you will receive at least three weeds and 3 Farming experience. It is recommended to store the weeds inside a compost bin to create compost for future plots. After digging the wheat plot, place the wheat seeds in your inventory (or equip the seeds) and left-click on the plot. You will receive 5 Farming experience for planting the wheat seeds. After spreading the seeds, you will need to water the wheat plot at each stage by equipping a full watering can. You can fill your watering can by pressing the key on a pond of water. Water the wheat plot five times until you see a check mark at the bottom of the watering icon. You will need to wait half an in-game day (12 minutes client-side) for the wheat chute to grow into a wheat stalk.

Once the wheat chute grows into a wheat stalk, water the plot five times again. At any time during the process, not watering the plant after six in-game hours after the next phase will result in the wheat chute becoming diseased. You will not be able to create plant cure, so you will have to start again.

After waiting another in-game day, the wheat stalk will turn into harvestable wheat. Harvest the wheat before talking to the Wise Old Man again, and he will reward you with a pack of Farming supplies.
quests.rewards:
• Spare farmer's supplies, containing:
    • Plant cure
    • Tome of Farming - Vol 2
  • Level 3 Farming
    • The ability to make plant cure
objectives: Speak to the Wise Old Man, in Bramblemead, to learn about the Farming skill.
Return to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead.
Grow and harvest your first crop from a farming plot.

quests.name: Shrimp Catcher
quests.lead: Shrimp Catcher is a secondary tutorial quest meant to teach you the basics of the Fishing skill.
quests.desc: The Wise Old Man has some tips on how to grow as an amateur angler.
quests.start: Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Valley after creating a fishing net.
quests.item_req:
• 2 coarse thread for the coarse net.
  • 1 ash logs
  • 1 coarse thread
  • 1 raw sardine
quests.walkthrough:
To start this quest, create a coarse net at the crafting table. This will trigger the quest for you to speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Valley. Speak to him and choose option 2. This will make him remark about how you made yourself a very useful tool (remarking about the net) and remember in his very distant youth about spending countless hours catching something in a local pond with a net and how the owners weren't happy. He then says about how you can find yourself a nice spot to relax and wile away the dull hours of daylight between adventures and to challenge yourself to finding that single pristine fish. He continues about how he hadn't eaten a good fish in ages and asks you to catch him a sardine in the Brynmoor waters, but tells you that you'd need to use a fishing rod to catch one and craft bait to aid you.

Note: This will start the next objective, which is to capture a raw sardine.

He then begins to tell you that you can boil, roast, stew, and make a lot of delicious meals out of them. He also says that if you find really nice ones, you can put them on display. After this, you will be presented with four options to discuss fishing.

Gone Fishin!

Item(s) required: Any fishing net, Ash Rod.

In order to get to the sardines, you will need to get some Fishing levels.

Head to any nearby net fishing spot and stand within it while wielding your net to start trawling to capture raw shrimp, and you'll unlock shrimp bait. Keep capturing shrimp using your net until you reach level 3, where you'll unlock the ability to create Fishing Rods. Go to your crafting table and use 1 ash log and 1 coarse thread to make an ash rod, then with the shrimp you've caught, create some shrimp bait (each shrimp gives 1 bait).

Once you have your fishing rod and bait, head to a nearby rod fishing spot and fish there.

Unlike with net fishing, you will need to equip both your fishing rod and bait to start rod fishing. Hold down your cast button (LMB by default) and release it to start fishing, but it is possible to miss the spot if you cast too weakly or too strongly. Once you've successfully cast into the fishing spot, you will need to use your strafe left/right buttons (A and D buttons respectively) to tire out the fish. A bar will appear above the bottom-middle of your screen that will gradually disappear. If the bar remains blue, you will begin to tire out the fish, but if it is red, that means the fish is stronger and reeling in the fish will consume greater amounts of stamina. When the fish is tired out, an option will appear to reel in the fish.

When the bar is empty, you will have caught a fish. This can either be a sardine or a trout.

Note: Fishing will consume your stamina rapidly. If you do not reel in your fish quickly before depleting your stamina, your fish will escape.

Once you have caught your sardine, head back to the Wise Old Man.

Back to the grind!

Bringing the sardine you've caught back to him, the Wise Old Man will remark how you've caught a wonderful delicious sardine and how it brings back old memories. Before cooking the sardine like how his grampa used to, he rewards you for a job well done.

Congratulations! Quest complete!
quests.rewards:
• 1x Tome of Fishing - Vol 1
  • 3x feather bait

quests.name: Dragon Slayer
quests.lead: Dragon Slayer is the fifth primary quest and the first of the main story in RuneScape: Dragonwilds. This is where the player is introduced into the first major narrative arc of Ashenfall, also known as Kuldra's Saga, and their legend begins.
quests.desc: Recruited with promises of glory, your first challenge is to defeat General Velgar.
quests.start: Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village.
quests.req: First Steps
quests.item_req:
• 1 antlers
  • 23 ash logs
  • 1 coarse animal fur
  • 1 dragon tooth (iron pickaxe needed to gather)
  • 1 bloodwood sap (iron logging axe needed to gather)
  • 5 bronze bar
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons.
  • Food
  • Ranged or Magic weapon to kill the deer
  • Antipoison potions
quests.enemies:
• Multiple goblins and garou
  • Multiple giant rats and putrid rats
  • Multiple vault guardians
  • Velgar
quests.walkthrough:
Part I: To Slay Dragons!

To start this quest, speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead Village and he will instruct you on getting started with hunting down General Velgar. Before you can start hunting dragons, you need a shelter. He will tell you to build a little shelter, with at least a bed roll in it, which you have to claim. To be able to claim it, you need to build at least a foundation, 3 walls, and a ceiling, and place the bed roll in it. Once you finish your task, talk with him again.

He will tell you that one of the adventurers, young Cathan is missing and needs to be found. To do this, he will cast a locator spell, but he needs some antlers for that. Hunt down deers in the valley and bring the antlers to him. As they tend to run away, you need a ranged or magic weapon to kill them.

The spell will point you to a nearby castle within the valley, so this will be your next destination.

Part II: A Lost Adventurer...

When you arrive at the Keep of Blue Flames, it will look eerily similar to Lumbridge Castle, but with Bandosian banners flying. This place will have a lot of goblins, so pack some food. You will find Cathan's Journal lying at the top of the castle next to a loot chest. Read his journal and you will learn that you need to go to the Whispering Swamp to locate a "blue-flame door". At this point, Velgar will descend to the keep, spraying poison next to the gate, then attack with his poison puddles. You can either wait for his attack to end or just run out of the keep, dodging the strikes.

Journey through the "blue-flame door" (the dragonkin vault Vertentis Kara) and speak to Spitfoot at the end of the vault. He will detail Cathan's journey, his betrayal, and his desire to go to Ghornfell. Take this information back to the Wise Old Man in the Bramblemead Valley, and he will remark about Cathan's foolish recklessness. After telling you that if he is willing to brave the Garou, Cathan must have a way to deal with Velgar, he will ask you to dive into Ghornfell to pick up his trail.

Once you arrive in the Fractured Plains (an area of Ghornfell), you will then be prompted to go check out Velgar's Rise, a monumental tower at the heart of the region, for any information on Cathan's whereabouts.

Part III: The Beginnings of a Legend...

When you arrive at the Rise, you will encounter Cathan's ghost. Speak to him and he will talk about how he was so sure he could defeat Velgar (after remarking how death sucked). He will tell you that the Garou mobbed him and dragged him to the tower, holding him down in front of Velgar as they sacrificed him. He will then give you a recipe to make a challenge horn that can challenge Velgar in his tower.

You need to travel to both Bloodblight Swamp and Stormtouched Highlands to gather the materials for the horn.

  • In the Highlands you have to travel past the skeleton which the Garou use as home on the western part and you can find a dragon skull. You can mine it's teeth with an iron pickaxe to get the dragon tooth.
  • In the swamp, you have to travel to the castle on the most southern point. In the castle you can find the bloodwood tree (and some Garou), and you can harvest it with iron logging axe to gather the bloodwood sap.

    Combine them with 5 bronze bar and you can create the horn.

Part IV: Fight for your life

When you have the horn, grab your best armour and weapon, bring some antipoison potions and food, and enter Velgar's Rise. The top of the tower is basically a triangle, with a pedestal at the centre. When you place the horn on the dragonkin altar, Velgar will arrive on one corner.

He will use poison spray and poison puddle bombs or stomp both his legs, which will create spikes in your direction. If you get close to using melee, he will stomp one leg, which is closer to you, and also bite forward and hit sideways with his head. All of his attacks are delayed, so you can prepare and dodge, and between each attack he will wait a bit.

After he loses 1/4 of his health, he will fly away and use his poison puddle bomb attack multiple times. After that, he will land on another corner, the next of the previous one, clockwise. In the second phase, he will use multiple attacks one after another, before he waits a bit. The attacks are the same as in the previous phase.

After his health is brought to half, he will again fly away, and his signature attack will happen again. He will land again on another edge, still next to the previous one, clockwise, and the fight continues like before. He will once more fly away when he loses 3/4 of his health. He will land on the original edge, where he can be attacked again.

Once Velgar is defeated, you will get his head. Go outside of the tower, speak to the Wise Old Man (who has replaced Cathan's ghost), and give him the head to complete this quest.

Congratulations! Quest complete!
quests.rewards:
• Tome of Construction - Vol 1. (After being asked to get antlers)
  • Dragon Slayer reward packs,
    • After following Cathan into Ghornfell - containing 3 clay, 3 redberries, and 3 harralander.
    • End of quest - containing a Tome of the Dragon Slayer, a noxious draconic visage, and an anti-dragon shield.
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Withering Heights
objectives: Construct a base of operations in Bramblemead village. Build a shelter and claim a bed.
Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village.
Hunt a deer and bring one of its antlers to the Wise Old Man.
Siege the goblin castle and look for Cathan.
Investigate the blue-flame door in the swamp. Find out what Cathan is up to.
Speak to the Wise Old Man in Bramblemead village.
Gear yourself up and push forward into Ghornfell in search of Cathan.
Investigate Velgar's tower in search of Cathan.
Find the ingredients and craft the Challenge Horn. Check the recipe in your journal for more information.
Summon and defeat Velgar.
Bring Velgar's head to the Wise Old Man outside Velgar's Lair.

quests.name: Withering Heights
quests.lead: Withering Heights is the sixth primary quest and the second in the main storyline of RuneScape: Dragonwilds. This quest continues the Player's adventure into Ashenfall, after their victory over the poisonous earth dragon Velgar, and deeper into the continent's mysterious depths.
quests.desc: Put an end to the horror of Fellhollow by defeating Imaru, the soul-devourer.
quests.start: Speak to the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch.
quests.req: Dragon Slayer
quests.item_req: None
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Food
quests.enemies:
• Multiple rotsworn zombies
  • Multiple zombies
  • Multiple skeletons
  • Multiple green dragons
  • Imaru, the Soul-Eater
quests.walkthrough:
Part I: The omnious side...

To begin this quest, speak with the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch. He will explain that he had been studying a mysterious door with some sort of strange necromantic runes on it, and tells you the password to get past the door.

Use option 1 after speaking to the Wise Old Man, to open the door, and you will arrive at the Forgotten Temple. As there is already a lodestone here, you will not need to spend your own materials to make a lodestone. Step up the steps and head into the temple to speak to Death, who will inform you about Imaru and the overall situation in Fellhollow. You will then follow out the right side (your right) towards a place where you can speak to Postie Pete about entering Fellhollow, but before you do, Death will say one more thing. This will, inevitably, introduce you to his store, where you can buy (using soul fragments) exclusive rare items that cannot be acquired through vestiges and normal gameplay.

Note: There will be a small intro cutscene that plays when you first enter Fellhollow.

Part II: Fraying the soul to rift...

Next, speak to Postie Pete. He will then explain that, in order to get into Fellhollow, you must cross a river of wither water. As you cross through the water, you will build up Wither and feel your soul rift. Just before crossing fully, you will enter the soul rift state and be able to use the nearby spectral door. Enter this door, and you will arrive in one of the regions that make up Fellhollow: Bleakfields Valley. As soon as you arrive, you must quickly find a fountain (marked on your compass with visible blue beacons) to purify your soul, for Imaru will have sensed your arrival into her domain. The longer you are in this state, the more danger you are in, as the tormented souls (human, wolves, etc) will start to appear at growing power levels.

For this instance of arrival, quickly follow the path, and you will reach one such fountain. You will have to hit the spectral tangles until they disappear to be able to purify your soul.

Once you arrive in this place, seek out Cathan. He will be nearby on a cliff, floating next to three stone tablets with strange markings.

Note: After arriving in Fellhollow for the first time (aka accessing the temple and soul-rifting through the spectral door), you will be granted permanent access to Fellhollow in all worlds.

Part III: Disrupting the seal

Speak to Cathan to uncover what else to do next, which is to gather curse fragments. There are only three you need to collect:

  • Curse fragment (grief)
  • Curse fragment (rage)
  • Curse fragment (despair)

Once you have acquired all three curse fragments, you will then be able to gain access to Imaru's Tower in the centre of Hope's Fall.

Curse fragment (grief) - Emberwood

To get this fragment, you will need to interact with four pillars that are nearby to dispel a divine barrier. You will need to find the corresponding shrines (which can be activated in any order) to dispel it.

Once all of the altars are activated, the barrier will be dispelled, allowing you to enter Emberwood Village and obtain the curse fragment (grief).

Note: If you start a fresh world, regardless of how far you have done the quest or fully completed it, you will need to re-activate all of the statues to dispel the barrier.

Shrine to Guthix
  • Guthix altar: Defeat a green dragon (can be safespotted with ranged attacks, must be at least 150m away to avoid the dragon attacking) and interact with it. It will be within a druid circle to the west.

    Note: The Guthix altar will not allow interaction until the green dragon has been defeated.

Shrine to Saradomin
  • Saradomin altar: A bit north-east, you will find it atop a lone rock within a small lake. You will need to repair this altar first by finding the Saradomin symbol down below (in the water) and interact with it again.
Shrine to Armadyl
  • Armadyl altar: A bit east of where you defeated the green dragon, on a small island in the river, there are three ghosts who have committed a grave injustice. You must find the perpetrator and solve the crime in order to activate this altar.
    • Choose the following options:
    • 3 - There was a mass murder.
    • 2 - Because they thought it was funny.
    • 3 - The snickering ghost
    • 3 - They found it too funny. Matching the motive. (The option about the weather also works)
Shrine to Zamorak
  • Zamorak altar: You will need to enter a nearby temple through the roof and jump into the temple to interact with the altar. There is a lever nearby to open the gate to the temple so you can leave freely.
Curse fragment (rage) - Lake of Lost Souls

To obtain this fragment, you must venture into the Vekchenven Kara vault that is underneath a waterfall. You will need to defeat a zogre at the end of the dungeon in order to access this shard. Once you defeat the zogre, you will then be free to obtain the curse fragment (rage).

Curse fragment (despair) - Silverthorn Keep

To obtain this fragment, you will need to venture into the keep itself. There will be many rotsworn zombies, skeletal archers, rotsworn warriors, rotsworn marauders, and zombies in the way as you head up towards the fragment, but there will be a green dragon in front of it. Interact with the curse seal, and you will obtain the curse fragment (despair).

Part IV: Imaru's end...

Item(s) required: curse fragment (rage), curse fragment (grief), curse fragment (despair).

Item(s) recommended: food, power level 5 gear, and potions.

Go into the tower within Hope's Fall and interact with the seal on Imaru's lair. You will then be prompted to enter her lair by dispelling the curse, and by choosing option 1, you will be able to enter her lair. Upon entering her lair, there will be four purifying pools, spots of wither rot, and an atmosphere of death and decay. Imaru will come out of the nearby river in front of you, and you'll be able to fight her. Be warned, as this boss will phase in and out of the soul rift state and attempt to heal herself by devouring souls.

Once she is defeated, you will gain Imaru's head. Make sure to have one free inventory space to complete the quest. Now you will head back to Death, who will exclaim that Imaru is dead and that you've done well to deal with a potential problem that he didn't want to deal with. Hand him Imaru's head and you will complete the quest.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!
quests.rewards:
• Withering Heights reward pack
    • Tome of the Undying
    • Undead draconic visage
    • Dragoncurse shield
  • Access to a new type of masterwork recipe: the dragoncurse shield.
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Black Knight's Fortress
objectives: Speak to the Wise Old Man near Ashien's Watch.
Unlock the strange door.
Speak to the temple's inhabitant.
Speak to Death.
Speak to Postie Pete.
Enter Fellhollow.
Remove the Soul Rift at a Purification Pool.
Find Cathan and look into what he was investigating.
Get location of curse fragments 0/3.
Get location of curse fragments 1/3.
Get location of curse fragments 2/3.
Gather three curse fragments from the locations described in the standing stones.
Gather two more curse fragments from the locations described in the standing stones.
Find the last curse fragment from the locations described in the standing stones.
Enter the Shattered Spire and defeat Imaru.
Bring Imaru's head to Death.

quests.name: Black Knight's Fortress
quests.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
quests.lead: Black Knight's Fortress is the seventh primary quest and the third in the main storyline of RuneScape: Dragonwilds. In this quest, the Player must delve into an ancient mountainous fortress after defeating the revenant dragon Imaru in order to gain access to the Umbral Sands.
quests.desc: Uncover the secrets of Dowdun Reach in order to unlock your way through to the Umbral Sands.
quests.start: Speak to Death in the Forgotten Temple.
quests.req:
• Withering Heights
  • Level 41 Cooking to cook maple sap into maple syrup, or a maple toastie from a food salvage spot (1/24)
quests.item_req:
• Steel or Undead Spade
  • Steel or Mithril Pickaxe
  • Mithril Logging Axe
  • Fishing Rod (Any, preferably highest available)
quests.rec:
• Good food, potions
  • Good armour
quests.enemies:
• Multiple Black Knights
  • Multiple mage of Zamorak
  • Multiple hellhounds
  • Four (different location) shardbound lesser demons
  • Lesser demon
  • Blue dragon
  • Black Knight Titan
quests.walkthrough:
Part I: The Dark Fortress...

Speak to Death in the Forgotten Temple. He will mention about how you did well in Fellhollow, but that there is more for you to do. A colleague of his is waiting for you in the Umbral Sands to help him, but instructs you to speak to Cathan to gather allies and investigate. You can find Cathan east of Fellhollow, near the ominous gatehouse in the south of Silverthorn Keep.

Speak to Cathan, who greets you, and he will comment about how the adventure never ends. He will then right to it and explain how he has been investigating the ominous gatehouse and, while it leads to some fortress, it is blocking the way to the Umbral Sands. He tells you how he wanted to scout out the place more all spooky-like, but made the mistake of mentioning it to the Wise Old Man. Knowing how he is like, Cathan mentioned about how he murmured some stuff like "amateur hour wards" and "rubbish defences" before storming down the passageway. Cathan will inform you that, if you want to go after him, to look for him in some sort of central point (like a nexus or something). Go through the open gateway and enter through the ominous door (Image right).

Note: This will play a small intro cutscene to the area.

You will then arrive within The Approach. Traverse southward through this new region until you enter The Courtyard where you will meet the Wise Old Man.

Part II: Shadows Within

Speak to the Wise Old Man, who will mention about how you had an easier time getting here than they did and walloping a few troublesome people. He'd then mention about how he was hoping to hunt down another dragon to whittle down Kuldra's forces, but complains about the fortress full of Zamorakians in the way. Despite the bothersome trouble in the way, he mentions how great it is that you're here to help get them moving again. Troubling thing is, he mentions how the way is blocked by someone called "the gatekeeper" and he isn't sure who or what it may be. Despite not being aware of who or what it is, the Wise Old Man tells you that Doric is currently working on dispelling a nasty magical barrier further ahead in the Nexus. He then says how it might be a good idea to make a base camp here first.

After making a base camp, follow the path leading up into the fortress. Arrive at The Nexus and speak to Doric. Once you speak to him, he will mention about how crazed the Black Knights are along with how they look like they should have all died long ago. He mentions how the problem is that you are all stuck here and he has everything to get the door open. As far as Doric can tell, everything seems to be connected to a great big stone next to him. He says that it looks broken and, theorising a way to get past the door, might need to fix it using some missing pieces. Inspect the stone.

This will reveal a small dialogue from the stone itself describing how it is broken, shards of itself are missing, and that you should find the missing pieces to repair it. It will then give you authorisation to look around the keep and to access the Nexus nodes scattered around Dowdun Reach.

Part III: Shard Hunting

Item(s) needed: Spade, Pickaxe, Logging Axe.

After inspecting the Dreaming Stone, you will discover that there are thirteen shards (marked on your map with yellow circles) that are needed to repair it. These shards are scattered throughout Dowdun Reach and require you to either interact with characters, scenery objects, or solve puzzles to acquire them. While most are above-ground, there are three that are kept underground. Once you have collected all thirteen shards, head back to the Dreaming Stone.

The Cathedral
LocationInteract TypeDetails
South-WestCut down vines w/ mithril logging axe then standard interactYou can acquire the cathedral shard by heading south-west to a courtyard full of Zamorakian acolytes and mages and, using your mithril (or above) logging axe, cut down the vines. As the mages and acolytes are hostile by default, you will need to take them down first.
The Garrison
LocationInteract TypeDetails
EastDefeat Sergeant BlisterHe is located underground in The Garrison region, protected by two hellhounds and a small host of skeletons. The requirements to interact/collect this shard are the same as defeating the shardbound lesser demons.
WestStandard interactNavigate past the elite Black Knight and two Zamorakian acolytes to an open wall with some wooden boards. Use the Windstep spell to jump up and across to the nearby adjacent tower. Once you have arrived, either defeat or avoid the elite Black Knight to interact with the shard.
The Grand Hall
LocationInteract TypeDetails
EastInteract with SpittletoeSpittletoe instructs you to collect five Maple Sap. Once you provide the sap, Spittletoe will trade you the shard.
Grand Hall shard steps
The Library
LocationInteract TypeDetails
North-WestDefeat 2x shardbound lesser demon

Open the library door by interacting with (in order) the following books:

  1. The Empty Throne
  2. The Eye of Oculus
  3. Taking the Crown
  4. Zamorak's Rebellion

Note: You can make it easier to take them down by leading them into the spiral staircase. Despite the player needing to interact with the doorway to phase through, the lesser demons can walk through the doorway as if it is not there.

South-WestInteract with ValeriusGo to the top of the staircase (a floor above where Valerius can be found) and West, past the blue dragon, and veer right as soon as you pass under the cliff. Equip your spade and dig in front of the gargoyle statue to uncover the glass owl. Return this item to Valerius to acquire this shard.
The Menagerie
LocationInteract typeDetails
South
  • Dig with spade
  • Cut down vines w/ mithril logging axe

Find three levers to unlock the door. The first lever is inside of the broken down roof of the tiny house (located next to the windmill). You'll need to cast Windstep to reach the roof, then use your spade here to dig it up and interact with it. The second lever is inside of a cave nearby protected by a thorny vine wall along the rock wall to the right of the shard. You will need a mithril or better logging axe to chop these vines. The third and final lever is on the top level of the nearby stone ruins, located beside the air anima vent. You'll need to use Windstep to reach this level.

This area is guarded by a lesser blue dragon.

South-EastStandard interact

Follow along the lower area cliffs to reach an area where you can jump across. You'll also locate a group of hellhounds on your way there, but you can either ignore them or defeat them until you locate a series of beams. Traverse the beams by jumping up to the next level until you reach the top where you'll need to jump across to the stone rock where the shard is located. Note: You'll need plenty of air runes to use Windstep for this particular jumping puzzle.

An alternative way is to equip your leggings of lightness and use Windstep from where you received the previous shard from finding the three levers, down to the cliffs. Be sure not to jump and head down, instead, fall with the spell and the leggings to avoid damage.

The Pastures
LocationInteract TypeDetails
NorthMine a granite deposit

Reach the highest part of the goblin-infested fortress. In the middle of the area, there is a granite deposit that hides the shard. You can either avoid or defeat the blue dragon here to get to the shard, but you can use the Rocksplosion spell to quickly interact with the shard.

EastInteract buttonDefeat the goblins in the immediate area of the shard before interacting with it.
Underground Shards

These are located underground, they can be completed in any order.

The Crypt (underground)
LocationInteract TypeDetails
The CryptDig with spade/shovel

Navigate to The Crypt in the underground region. Before searching for the shard, defeat the zogre here. This will save you trouble later. Interact with the note next to the goblin corpse to learn that the shard is buried in a grave. Dig at any of the graves until you uncover the shard. Note: The location of this shard is randomized for every world.

The Demon Gate (underground)
LocationInteract TypeDetails
The demon gateDefeat 2x shardbound lesser demon

Navigate to the lowest part of the region. There is a lever-activated elevator that will take you down to the demon gate region. For easier traversal later, interact with the nearby nodestone to connect it to the Nexus. Navigate through the pathways until you reach the stone structure and defeat the two lesser demons guarding the shard.

The Lake (underground)
LocationInteract TypeDetails
The LakeSpeak with Offalfoot

He will ask you to give him one of the fish nearby (requires an empty inventory slot), so you'll need to grab one from the nearby pool of fish. This will give you an unusual trout and give this trout to Offalfoot. He'll give you the shard. Note: You do need a fishing rod (the highest level is recommended) and this can be done with level 1 Fishing. You will encounter Delrom when traversing to through this location.

Part IV: Remember the Titans

Interact with the Dreaming Stone. It will say that it is restored, but it will reveal that it was evil! It will claim that its name will rattle in your tiny skull like the echoes within a cave. The Dreaming Stone then reveals its name to be Avisk the eternal whose mind had ever graced the Aughra, but as it tries to enslave you and become its thrall, it seemed stunned. This will reveal two dialogue options (both of which are about destroying the stone), but choose option one. This will force the crystal to acknowledge your logic and, in its own way, apologise for being overzealous and how it happens when you've been alone in the psyche of Black Knights for too long. It then blames the Cthonian before taking down the barrier.

It then warns you to be wary of Lord Rasmodel (aka the Black Knight Titan) as it had a bit of a mishap when he smashed the Dreaming Stone to pieces. Now, he's got some of the Dreaming Stone , some of a demon, and a whole lot of anger issues. End the dialogue and the Dreaming Stone will be fully repaired.

Interact with the newly-dropped Barrier and you'll arrive in The Bastion. Head up all the stairs (be mindful of some gaps which can be Windstepped) until you reach the top. Enter into the Bastion building and, just past a barrier, slay the boss. Interact with the barrier to fight the Titan. After defeating him, return to the Dreaming Stone.

Note: The barrier may not allow you to teleport through if you have not unblocked all of the nodestones; with the exception of The Bastion.

Part V: To the Umbral Sands!

Talk to the Dreaming Stone/Avsik. It will remark how impressive it was that you slew the Titan and that when he finds himself a new body to walk among the world again, he'd like for you to work with him. Aside from that, he remarks about how the gate to the Umbral Sands hasn't been opened in a long time, so he'll need time to get it unstuck. He also pleads for you to be patient - and to stay your hammer - as he will help get you into the desert soon. He then gives you a reward (read: bribe) for not smashing him to pieces with your hammer.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!

quests.name: Icthlarin's Little Helper
quests.lead: Icthlarin's Little Helper is the eighth primary quest and the fourth in the main storyline of RuneScape: Dragonwilds. In this quest, the player proceeds past the door to the Umbral Sands after spilling the blood of the Black Knight Titan to uncover the mysteries of the desert, build reputation with the local Moon Garou clans, and defeat the tyrant Fuzan before finally entering the Scorned Wilderness.
quests.desc: Slay the tyrant dragon Fuzan and unite the Moon Garou along the way
quests.start: Enter the Umbral Sands using the Door to Umbral Sands.
quests.req: Black Knight's Fortress
quests.item_req:
• Mithril pickaxe or better for the adamantite ore.
  • Adamant logging axe or better for resources.
  • Any spade (Adamant recommended)
  • 1x clean water
  • 3x adamant bars
  • 3x of each: Raw farm meat, kalphite shell fragments, and cactus steaks

  • Ash Logs for building temporary shelters.
  • Vault Cores, Rune Essence, and Stone for lodestones.
  • Drinks that can reduce buildup of Scorch.

  • Multiple KotHaar
  • Multiple red dragons
  • Fuzan
quests.walkthrough:
Part I: Starting off

Note: Interacting with the door to the Umbral Sands will play a small introduction cutscene to the region.

After defeating the Black Knight Titan and talking to Avisk, head back to The Bastion and interact with the door to the Umbral Sands. It is highly recommended that you do this during the night cycle at full rest. Once you have interacted with the door, you will arrive at the Alcarrid Oasis sub-region. Speak to Shangruuh right as you arrive to start the quest.

Arriving to the camp, speak to Ancamairon, who will next to Icthlarin. Icthlarin requests one of the mirror lens they hold in order to use the mirrors and break the seal that blocks Fuzan's tower. The garou does not trust an outsider, let alone a demigod, with their sacred item. So you will be asked to gain the trust of the Moon Garou, starting with the Alcarrid camp.

Once you accept the quest, you'll need to speak to certain NPCs to progress.

Speak to any of them to start the tasks needed to convince the elder of the Alcarrid tribe.

Rogue Trader

Item(s) required: Mithril pickaxe (or better), inventory space.

Speak to Domri who will request that you locate three moonstones that are likely hidden in the western area of the desert under some gypsum nodes within rocky areas or caves. The map and compass will direct you to the locations. Be sure to check each nodes to find the moonstone. Once you visit all three locations, return to Domri, who will be shocked that the moonstones are real and will reward you with his trust and access to his shop.

Top moonstone map location

Top moonstone player view entrance

Top moonstone under this pile of gypsum

Middle moonstone short video:

Bottom moonstone short video:

Note: By completing reputation quests, you can unlock more items to trade with him including unique vestiges.

The Mirror Crack'd

Item(s) required: 3 adamant bar. If mining the materials: a mithril pickaxe (or better), 9 adamantite ore and 9 coal.

Speak to Valas, and they will remark about how your task to repair the mirrors smells like folly to them. They commend your spirit, but then tell you how the mirrors are sacred to them because of the River Goddess placing them there to remind them of who must protect Umbral Sands.

Speak to Valas again when you have the bars. Click on option 1 to hand over the bars, and they will say that they will fix the mirrors for you when you collect all of the lenses. They will inform the elder of your part in getting that job done and give you a nice farewell. They will also give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Rag and Bone Garou

Item(s) required: 3 raw farm meat, 3 kalphite shell fragments, and 3 cactus steaks

Speak to Lagra, who wants you to help them with a task and clarifies that they are a butch (or butcher) and want you to bring them three of the following: Raw farm meat, kalphite shell fragments, and cactus steaks. You can collect the raw farm meat from nearby vultures, goats, or from your own chests if you have any. The shell fragments can also be found by killing kalphites in the desert or if you have some already. As for cactus steaks, you only need to chop down one or two bunny cactuses with an adamant (or better) logging axe or collect them from your chests.

Speak to Lagra again when you have the items. Choose option 1 to hand over the meats, and they will praise your work by saying that you have an eye for dead tissue and exoskeletons. They will give you their trust and give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Once you have completed the three tasks above, return to Ancamairon. He will mention that the Alcarrid clan now trusts you and that the butcher has even made a dish after you.

Reward: Moon Garou pack and a new Magic Carpet mount.

After completing the tasks for the Alcarrid clan, you now have to navigate to other areas of the desert to collect their lenses. You can go to either the Manafem clan in the southern area of the desert (within the Manafem Plains) or the Uzzer clan in the east (within the Dunes of Uzzer) and speak to their respective elders to discuss building reputation and claiming the lenses.

Part II: Manafem Trouble

Speak to Dúshlánach in the Manafem camp. They will mention that you are a bad omen at a bad time, calling you Unmarked, and reveal they bear the Mark of Fuzan and how that mark is a wound that carves deep. From this Mark, they are slowly losing their will to fight and their sanity, but they do say that their pride is not being lost. They say that while the clan needs help, they are reluctant to accept it. This means that their tasks will be somewhat harder. Just like with the Alcarrid clan, there are three tasks that must be done to acquire their lens.

Note: Beartach will not offer any quests, but completing the reputation quests will increase his reputation by one level.

Song of the Ancients

Item(s) required: Good weapons, armour, food and 5 air runes

Speak to Laguna, who is sitting next to a net fishing spot. They would like you to venture into the Vault located south of the camp and write down the lyrics of the songs as they do not like beetles and heard that beetles reside within the vault.

The vault they spoke of will be circled in green on your map. Be warned that this is a kalphite nesting area, so you will need to rush to the entrance to avoid being outnumbered by kalphites and KotHaar that lurk around the area.

Enter the vault door and head towards the next platform. You will need to summon a scarab staff and take it with you, as this will prevent the scarabs within the dungeon from hurting you. After summoning the staff, the first ancient garou statue will be to the right. Collect this before continuing deeper into the vault.

You will be in combat sometime, and the staff can be swapped for you to protect yourself, which will allow you to pick the staff back up. In the first room, follow the path that leads to a lever, pull it but to not proceed as east of the lever there is a ancient garou statue for you to transcribe. Follow the path and head into the next room, where the statue will be located on top of a platform, requiring Windstep to reach. Now that you have acquired all of the lyrics, you may return to Laguna in the Manafem camp.

Note: The next two levers will open the way to one of the Kalphite Queens. If you are prepared, you can enter the encounter to claim extra reward on beating her, such as the keris' vestige, corroded curved blade.

Speak to Laguna again and they will be happy that you found them all and wants to weave them into a song. After that, they promise to vouch for you with the Manafem Elder.

Scaling Difficulties

Item(s) required: Good weapons, armour, and food.Speak to Hedric, he'll tasks you with looking for his lost scouting party. The scouting party were tracking a creature that had been picking off his people one by one and asks you to look for them towards the east and kill the beast.

After talking with Hedric, head towards the green area on your map east from the Manafem camp. Within that area, there will be three clues in the area, two dead garou scouts and a scorched mark. You'll learn that the scouting party is dead, and Neither the Scorch, the sandstorms or Fuzan could have made them, but something else. Head further east to where the green circle is on your map and you will find a red dragon. Kill it and gain the radiant heart.

Head back to Hedric and speak with him and you will recount how you found their bodies and slain the red dragon nearby. He will thank you for finding their bodies and, that now you made it safe, will send someone to go collect their bodies. He will remark that the dragon you slain is small-fry compared to Fuzan, hopes you know what your doing, and recommended you to their Elder. He will give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Beast in the Sand

Item(s) required: 1 clean water.

Speak to Manathep and she will tell you about how the Dearg Due killed her poor Efina. She mentions that Efina was taken three days ago and every night, the Dearg Due watches her from the south of their camp with a glint in her eye and blood on her lips. She asks you to kill the Dearg Due south of the camp and bring back Efina's body.

Head west of the pyramid vault and track down the Dearg Due in the sandstorm. Follow it until you meet Efina. Speak to her and she will ask for clean water. Give her some clean water and she will say that her strength is coming back to her while thanking you. she then reveals that she ran away from the Manafem camp due to the Mark of Fuzan draining everyone. She then asks you to tell her mum that she is safe and on her way back. The Dearg Due howls back, but you get the sense that a curse has been lifted and the Dearg Due is free to move on from this world.

Return to speak to Manathep. She will praise the River Goddess in joy that her daughter is safe and thinks that the Dearg Due lured her out of the camp as a trick and says the Efina wouldn't go out there alone. She will then give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Once you have completed these tasks, speak again to Dúshlánach.

Reward: Level 4 reputation with Beartach - The Merchant's shop, 1 mirror lens, and a Moon Garou pack.

Part III: Heart of Uzzer

Speak to Gaimbín within the Dunes of Uzzer, who will doubt your skills and warns you to leave as they needed to prepare for the event of Fuzan's Marking. Of course you'll be once again tasked to gain the clan's trust in order for the elder to reward you with the mirror lens.

The Dig Site

Item(s) required: 1 spade of any kind, good weapons, armour and food to defend yourself from the KotHaar.

Speak to Lehran who asks that you help him learn the truth of his ancestors and he will vouch for you with the elder. He tells you that there are some ruins to the far south, long lost to the sands, and that the KotHaar have prevented him from travelling there himself. He reveals that the Forbidden Scrolls are meant to tell the truth about what happened to the Moon Garou centuries ago and not the stuff fed to them by their Elders. He asks for you to go dig them up and bring back the scrolls to him, offering to also share the revelations with you if there are any.

Head to the area marked on your map, with your spade in your inventory/hotbar. In order to find the scrolls, you will need to locate areas that are similar to buried chests. Each Forbidden Scroll will be in one specific ruin with two of them hidden behind locked gates. As there will be KotHaar and goats in the area, you will have to fight them in order to dig peacefully. There are four scrolls you will need to find and they are the following:

  • 'The Schism'
  • 'Sun Demon'
  • Old Kingdom'
  • 'Moon Goddess'

Once you have all four scrolls, return to Lehran. Give him the scrolls and he will then give you 200 garou chit for your troubles.

Saga of the Adventurer

Item(s) requires: 1 torch, good weapons, armour and food to better defend yourself against wandering enemies.

Speak to Laguna and they will tell you that they are on the market for a business partner and one with survival skills. They will tell you that there are four rocky spires around the pyramid close to this camp and that each spire holds a statue. They will ask you to go find each statue and note down the inscribed passages. Each passage, woven together, will form a saga. They will give you a book and reminds you to note down the passages at the rocky spires.

Head towards the area marked on your map. You will find that there are towering rocky spires around the area of the Pyramid and you must interact with them. Some of these statues will be hidden in caves blocked by sandstone nodes and others will be protected by either KotHaar or kalphites. Inspect each statue to gain a piece of the saga. Once you have collected enough pieces of the saga, you will then need to follow a direction pointing towards a specific direction. Head towards the spire with the Nightmare Crucible of Humilitation entrance and there will be the last ancient garou statue containing the full saga.

Once you have the complete saga, return to Laguna. They will congratulate you on finishing the saga and would enjoy performing at Fuzan's Mark Day, but for now, they will sing praises of your deeds to the elder. They also remark that you are free to unlock and explore the gateways as you see fit.

Note: You will gain a Crucible Engram of Humiliation for completing this segment.

Mark Day

Item(s) requires: Good weapons, armour and food to better defend yourself against wandering enemies.

Speak to Shangruuh and he will inquire why the Uzzer garou have to be so insufferable. He says that he came here to trade goods, but was told that the clan were busy preparing for Mark Day. He'll ask you to convince each council member to abandon the tradition of Mark Day

There will be three green circles on your map. North of the camp, you'll need to find Brialka the historian councillor, Chirot the Broker Councillor and Alabrais the Science Councillor. Each one will need to be convinced on abandoning Mark Day.

Follow the dialogue options in order for each councillor to secure their vote.

NPCDialogue options
Alabrais the Science Councillor
  • Fuzan's Aim to control you.
  • There is only evidence Fuzan destroys
  • Fuzan's constant is control over others
Brialka the Historian Councillor
  • You're making a choice that will affect generations
  • A garou alliance would make us stronger
  • The garou have always united to survive
Chirot the Broker Councillor
  • Lose money on the deal
  • Fuzan takes a cut
  • Fuzan will steal what you plan to steal

Once you're done, return to the camp and speak to the elder.

Rewards: 1 Moon Garou pack, mirror lens and level 4 in Iasadair - The Merchant's shop.

Part IV: Fuzan Trials

Item(s) required: Good weapons, armour, and food.

Visit Fuzan/Strategies for a guide to fighting Fuzan.

Speak to Icthlarin and he will say that there is little time to waste and that we must repair the mirrors. He informs you that he has positioned them carefully and believes they are directed at Fuzan's Lens, which is a dragonkin relic that protects both his volcano and powers his Mark. That belief, he says, will be tested now and prays to Elidnis for help if he's wrong. Interact with each of the mirrors to repair them fully and they will create a beam of concentrated sunlight directly towards Fuzan's tower. This is where you will be able to enter the Fight Caves and work your way towards Fuzan.

Note: The activity you will enter will only have the "Trials of Fuzan" mode by default. As this activity is not safe, you will lose your items and respawn at your bed.

Head towards The Burning Spire and interact with the volcanic gateway at the base of Fuzan's Volcano. This will let you enter the Fight Caves and you must interact with the podium in the area to start the fight. Fight and survive through all ten waves of the trial and you will unlock the path to Fuzan's Lair. Interact with the door to Fuzan's Lair and you will be able to fight Fuzan. Defeat him and obtain his head.

Once you get his head, return to Icthlarin.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!

quests.walkthrough:
In the ruined village north-west of the Wise Old Man, locate and interact with the crumbling well to receive the ghostspeak amulet. (Note: The amulet goes to the quest-item tab of your inventory instead of your basic inventory.) Next, speak with four ghosts throughout the Bramblemead Valley and Whispering Swamp. The ghosts are only visible from sunset to sunrise..

  • Warren's spirit is located in a dilapidated house in the south-west corner of the ruined village.
  • Lazina's spirit is located in a broken house to the south-east of the windmill in the Temple Woods and is along the walking path.
  • Finn's spirit is located inside a cave blocked by thorny vines to the south-east of the Wise Old Man. Cast Windstep to reach the lip of the cave, and then use a logging axe to destroy the thorns blocking the entrance.
  • Kay's spirit is located in a ruined house in the Whispering Swamp along the border with the Bramblemead Valley.

After meeting with all four ghosts, travel to the Remembrance Shrine located outside at the south-west corner of the church where players first spawn. The shrine is a large, stone flower vase atop a stone sculpture. Interact with the statue and select each option to "remember" all four ghosts.

Quest completed.

• A logging axe and 20 Woodcutting (if searching the guild reliquary)
  • One steak (if bribing a caged goblin for the reliquary location)
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons (ranged or magic when fighting the garou druid)
  • Anti-poison potions
  • Air runes to cast Windstep
  • Food and water
  • 32 stone, 20 rune essence, and 1 vault core to build a lodestone to Zanik
quests.enemies:
• Multiple Goblins
  • Garou druid
quests.walkthrough:
Starting off

Zanik will tell the player they sense the presence of a prophecy in the Outlook Ruins to the north-east of her, as well as in the Adventurer's Guild to the south. Both areas are overrun with goblins, so make sure you're properly equipped to take on the challenge with health potions, food, and water.

It is recommended that you place a lodestone at Zanik's location, as you'll have to come back to Zanik to complete the quest. This way, you can easily fast travel back to the location.

Bandosian Amulets

You can choose to either search the nearby ruins first or the Adventurer's Guild first. Both contain a reliquary containing the Bandosian amulet, but only one can be looted. The amulet in the location you didn't check first ends up stolen by a garou druid.

The ruins' reliquary is tucked away in a corner, whereas the guild reliquary is blocked by thorny vines, requiring 20 Woodcutting to cut down. The guild is also more dangerous due to the number of goblins inhabiting it, so it's recommended to obtain the amulet from the ruins' reliquary. Both locations have a caged goblin outside. Bilegut can be found outside the Outlook Ruins, and Wormelbow can be found outside the Adventurer's Guild. When talking to either of them before obtaining a Bandosian amulet, they'll offer to tell you the exact location of the respective reliquary in exchange for a steak. This is optional, as the reliquaries can be found without their help.

Next, you'll need to head to whichever location you did not obtain the Bandosian amulet from. If you obtained the amulet from the ruins, then head to the guild, and if you obtained the amulet from the guild, then head to the ruins. You don't need to defeat all the goblins there—simply locate the caged goblin and eliminate the goblins around it. Once the area is clear, speak with the caged goblin to learn the whereabouts of the second Bandosian amulet. The goblin will reveal that a garou-beastman has taken the second amulet to a cave in the Whispering Swamp.

Now, you must head to the cave in the swamp where a garou druid is keeping the second Bandosian amulet. However, the journey is not quite straightforward. The cave is located at the very bottom of the swamp, so be sure you go down into the swamp safely first, and then search for the cave. Otherwise, you will be running above the cave location and won’t be able to find the entrance. Once you've located the cave entrance, enter to find the garou druid. Defeat the garou druid to obtain the second Bandosian amulet. The garou druid is quite strong and can inflict a potent poison. To defeat it more easily, use magic attacks at a distance, and be sure to dodge its poison thorns.

Returning to Zanik

After obtaining both Bandosian amulets, return to Zanik. She will thank you for bringing the two amulets, and this will complete the quest. As a reward, Zanik will give you the goblin war banner.
quests.rewards: • Goblin war banner

quests.name: Highlighting the Problem
quests.lead: Highlighting the Problem is a secondary quest that can be started by examining the statue of a wizard in the Runecrafting Guild in Bramblemead Valley, on top of the cliffs directly north of the Temple Woods.
quests.desc: Explore the RuneCrafting Guild to discover the means to craft a powerful magical weapon.
quests.start: Interact with the statue of a wizard in the Runecrafting Guild in Bramblemead Valley.
quests.req: First Steps
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Food
quests.enemies: • Multiple Goblins
quests.walkthrough:
The statue requires a password. The password is found in the Thishepen Kara vault, found at the base of the cliff near the guild, in a room which requires Windstep to reach. You do not need to complete the whole vault; you can simply go for the password, which is found at a glowing blue statue hidden on an elevated path to your right in a room of four giant rats. The password is pthentorok.

Upon returning to the statue and giving it the password, a mysterious voice will talk to the player and give them a mysterious orb (uncharged). The player must then interact with three pedestals on the three towers surrounding the main tower in the guild. The player must use Windstep to reach the top of the towers, and can take advantage of surrounding rubble and other scenery.

After interacting with the three pedestals, the orb turns into the mysterious orb (charged), and the player must return to the first statue, which will then give the player the recipe for the staff of light, finishing the quest.
quests.rewards: • Recipe for staff of light
objectives: Investigate the area for clues about the statue.
Search the Runecrafting Guild for a statue.
Find a way to charge the  mysterious orb.
Return to the wizard statue.

quests.name: Granite Mauled
quests.lead: Granite Mauled is a secondary quest where players help Doric find valuable relics within Ashien's Watch.
quests.desc: Uncover the secrets of Ashien's Watch.
quests.start: Speak to Doric north-east of Fractured Plains.
quests.req: First Steps
quests.item_req:
• One slot space in their quest inventory
  • 5 or more air runes to cast Windstep or ash logs to cross the bridge
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Weak antipoison potions or better
quests.enemies:
• Multiple goblins and garou
  • Multiple giant rats and putrid rats inside the Vault
  • Multiple vault guardians
  • Exploding plant traps
quests.walkthrough:
Starting off

The quest can be started by talking to Doric north-east of Fractured Plains. Doric is located south of Ashien's Watch on a lookout with ruins on it. There's a broken bridge leading over to the other side as well. He will tell you that Ashien's Watch was where all the "valuable relics and supplies" were located during the time of the dragon, and he was looking for it. But he was chased away — and now he wants your help.

Skeklac Kara

Once you have located and activated all four statues in Ashien's Watch, enter the Skeklac Kara vault. Make sure to bring forms of antipoison (cooked food with poison resistance or some weak antipoison potions), as there are putrid rats and poisonous gas bubbles that explode and poison you. Make sure to check for blind spots, as the gas bubbles are in many corners and can deal high damage to the player. Upon reaching the lever that opens the vault corruptor's doors, the corruptor can deal high damage and poison in addition to putrid rats in the area. It is recommended to use ranged weapons or magic to avoid getting hit.

After defeating the boss at the end, interact with the statue, and you will receive a blueprint. Bring the blueprint back to Doric for translation.

Quest Completed!
quests.rewards:
• Recipe for granite maul (66-95 damage, 4 Combo - Special: Battering Ram)
  • Imbued granite maul head - placed in the player's quest items section of the inventory

You will need to craft these for the granite maul:

  • Imbued granite maul head
  • Imbued leather wrappings
  • Ornate maul handle
objectives: Investigate the secrets hidden below Ashien's Watch.
Find someone near Ashien's Watch that can translate ancient dwarvish.
Bring the blueprint to Doric in Ashien's Watch.

quests.name: Heartstrings
quests.lead: Heartstrings is a secondary quest that follows the story of an unnamed elf, leaving behind numerous stones spread across the area as they grieve their late human partner, Meya.
quests.desc: Sing the bard's song of rememberance.
quests.start: Interact with the memorial stone at the top of the hill at Fractured Plains.
quests.req: Getting Started
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Antipoison potions
  • Air runes to cast Windstep
quests.enemies: • Multiple garou
quests.walkthrough:
You can start this quest by interacting with a glowing blue memorial stone found next to a unique, large tree with blue leaves found in the Fractured Plains region. The tree is on top of where the first Fractured Plains dungeon is located. You can get to the top by casting the Windstep spell a few times up the rocks to the right of the cave where you access that dungeon. Upon searching the first memorial stone, players will receive a crystal seed in their quest inventory.

Memorial Stone Locations

There are a total of 7 memorial stones to be found, all in an eastward direction from the first. All quest progression points are therefore next to the unique trees with memorial stones found next to them. From the first tree, proceed eastward to find the next tree. As these trees are located in the open area of the Fractured Plains, it is recommended to be ready for combat with several wolves and garou that you will encounter during the quest.

Reaching the final tree and singing the song will complete the quest.
quests.rewards:
• Crystal bow
  • Recipe for crystal bow
objectives: Follow the memorial path, look for blue trees heading toward the east of Ghornfell and the memorial markers.

quests.name: Dog Days
quests.lead: Dog Days is a secondary quest given by Vannaka in the Stormtouched Highlands.
quests.desc: Investigate the Garou and their rituals.
quests.start: Speak to Vannaka at the centre of Stormtouched Highlands.
quests.req: N/A
quests.item_req:
• 2 ram horns
  • 3 shocking plant bulbs
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Food
  • Antipoison potions
  • Air runes to cast Windstep
quests.enemies:
• Multiple Garou and the Garou King
  • 1-2 rams
  • 1-2 wild lapulis vine
quests.walkthrough:
Investigate the Garou and their rituals

Talk to Vannaka, who is standing under a cliff in the eastern part of the Highlands (see the image). He will tell you about the garou and ask you to investigate their rituals.

Go to the location of the lore book, beneath the wyrm corpse, and read it. It is advised to go around and approach from the north, as there are fewer enemies. There is a garou thane next to the book, but facing the opposite direction, so you can sneak there and read the book.

Challenging the King

After you read the book, you have to defeat the Garou King and get his tainted token. Go to the castle in the north-west of the Highlands. Use Windstep as much as you can, to avoid as many enemies as you can. At the top of the hill, in the castle, you need to defeat the king, who is a thane, and his attacks are the same. It is suggested to cast Windstep onto the arches of the Garou King's ruined temple to safespot its attacks.

Ritual of Purification

Go back to Vannaka after you get the token. He will tell you that the token is tainted and needs to be purified. Head north to the location of Lougrim's Shrine, kill the garou druids there, and use it. The shrine will tell you that for the ritual, you need 2 ram horns and 3 Shock Bulbs, so kill rams and wild lapulis vines until you have enough materials. Then, go back to the shrine and perform the ritual of purification to receive a purified token.

Go back to Vannaka and talk with him.

Congratulations, Quest complete!
quests.rewards: • Garou highborn's cloak

quests.name: Cook's Assistant
quests.lead: Cook's Assistant is a secondary quest in the Fractured Plains. Players can start by talking to Slopfinger.
quests.desc: Help Slopfinger in Ghornfell bake a memorable cake for Manktongue.
quests.start: Speak to Slopfinger in the southwestern corner of the Fractured Plains.
quests.req: Farming skill unlocked and wheat gathered.
quests.item_req:
• 4 eggs
  • 7 wheats (One is for the cow)
  • 1 bucket of milk (can be obtained by cow outside of the building)
quests.rec: Ingredients to create a lodestone.
quests.enemies:
• Chickens for eggs (Alternatively cutting down trees works)
  • Goblins for wheat seed from their goblin packs
quests.walkthrough:
Collecting the ingredients

To start the quest, speak to Slopfinger, located in the south-west area of the Fractured Plains, near the border of the Stormtouched Highlands. Speaking to him, you learn that he is trying to make a cake, but his assistant, Manktongue, is ignoring him, so he asks you to assist him in showing that he can prove his worth as a chef. He'll ask you to collect 4 eggs, 6 wheats and 1 bucket of milk. The bucket of milk is the easiest ingredient; there is a cow just outside of the building within a pen. Interact with it and go through all the options, BUT do not milk it, as it will willingly give you milk.

For the rest of the ingredients, it is advised that you build a lodestone at the quest area so you can head over to Bramblemead Valley or Temple Woods to collect some eggs from chickens. Alternatively, you can chop down trees and get a bird nest. Killing goblins is required to collect wheat seeds, or looking through chests.

Finishing up

Once you collect all the ingredients, return to Slopfinger, and he will have you bake the cake for him. After baking the cake, speak to him again, and he will ask that you speak to Manktongue and show him the cake. Speak to Slopfinger one last time to complete the quest.

Congratulations, Quest complete!
quests.rewards: • Recipe to bake the Victoria sponge cake
objectives: Gather 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk, and bring them all to Slopfinger.
Bake a cake using the stove next to Slopfinger.
Bring the signed cake to Manktongue.

Give Slopfinger the good news.

quests.name: Animal Magnetism
quests.lead: Animal Magnetism is a secondary quest in the Fractured Plains. To start the quest, players must speak to Manktongue, who is located in a ruined house in the south western part of the Fractured Plains.
quests.desc: Create the Ava's Accumulator
quests.start: Speak to Manktongue in the southwestern corner of the Fractured Plains.
quests.req: • Decent armours and weapons
quests.item_req:
• 1 iron bar
  • 5 law runes
quests.rec: • Weak antipoison potion to travel through the Bloodblight Swamp
quests.enemies:
There are no enemies needed to fight, but the area to gather these items will have:

  • Putrid rats
  • Garous
  • Abyssal demon
quests.walkthrough:
Gathering the ingredients

To start the quest, speak to Manktongue, who will inform you that he found a message in a bottle in the water. Reading it will reveal that it is a message from Ava with the ingredients on how to craft her accumulator. Knowing the needed ingredients, you are asked to retrieve each of the following: 1 undead chicken, a bundle of undead twigs, and a magnet, which requires 1 iron bar and 5 law runes. If you already have the iron and law runes, take them to Pulpknuckle. He is located in the same cabin upstairs, who will create the magnet for you.

The undead chicken is located within the Stormtouched Highlands, directly north of the quest area. Enter the region, go up the hill, then search for an iron ore node on the wall. The chicken will be there (map on the bottom right). The Twig is located south of the entrance to Bloodblight Swamp (map on the bottom right). There is an undead tree; to get the twig, you will need to interact with it. Warning: An abyssal demon is known to roam around this area. Be cautious.

Finishing up

After you gather all the ingredients, return to Manktongue, who will create the device for you.

Congratulations, quest complete!
quests.rewards: • Ava's accumulator and the ability to create more.

quests.name: A Room With A Garou
quests.lead: A Room With A Garou is a secondary quest in the Fractured Plains. It can be started by talking to Caratacus.
quests.desc: An elder garou wants you to build a home that his late wife would be proud of.
quests.start: Speak to Caratacus in the northwestern corner of the Fractured Plains.
quests.req: None
quests.item_req: Ash logs or another building material to create a house around Caratacus.

quests.walkthrough:
Caratacus laments the passing of his wife, Cliodhina, who wanted to live in the area. He'll ask you to help him build a home, as he's unable to do so due to his blindness.

You can build the house however you like, but to finish the quest quickly, building 4 walls and a roof within the floor space is recommended. This requires a minimum of 20 ash logs, where players can create:

  • 4 walls
  • 1 45° roof

Once completed, speak to him again.

Congratulations, Quest complete!
quests.rewards: • Unlocked building decorations:
objectives: Build a home around Caratacus the Elder.

quests.name: The Great Body Robbery
quests.lead: The Great Body Robbery is a secondary quest. It can be started by speaking to Doctor Fenkenstrain in the Bloodblight Swamp.
quests.desc: Assist Dr Fenkenstrain in acquiring a new body. FOR SCIENCE!
quests.start: Talk to Doctor Fenkenstrain in the Bloodblight Swamp.
quests.req: Partial or full completion of Dragon Slayer.
quests.item_req:
• Bronze or better Spade.
  • 1x of each: Weak Antipoison potion, weak Focused Attack potion, weak Lumberjack potion
quests.rec:
• Weak or better antipoison potions for traversing the Bloodblight Swamp.
  • Good armour and food.
quests.enemies: None
quests.walkthrough:
To start this quest, speak to Doctor Fenkenstrain in the Bloodblight Swamp. He will be in his tower next to the garou camp around the bloodwood tree and on the same floor as the sanguine urn.

When you start talking to him, he will remark that they called him mad and that he'll show them. After a minute, he'll finally notice you and ask who you are. Choosing any option will result in him not caring who you are and asking you if you can help him out with something. He wants you to go collect some arms, legs, and that sort of stuff from graves all around the swamp. This will lead you to collect three items: Arms, Legs, Torso.

Locate graves by their headstones in the Bloodblight Swamp and use your spade/shovel near them to dig up a coffin. Interact with the coffin to collect the parts.

  • Human Torso: Near the abyssal demon. In the centre of three trees.
  • Goblin Legs: North of the torso coffin. Between two trees.
  • Garou Arms: Near the northern entrance to the Bloodblight Swamp.

Once you have all of the items, return to the doctor. Speak to him, and he will make a dumb pun about your unusual collection of body parts before asking you to place the parts on the examination table. Interact with the nearby examination table and speak to the doctor once more. He will ask you to examine the parts, and he will then ask you to bring him one weak antipoison potion, one weak Focused Attack potion, and one weak Lumberjack potion. Collect the potions and return to the doctor.

Use the potions (after speaking to the doctor again), and he will say that the body needs lightning, giving you an empty vial. You will need to get struck by lightning to fill the vial.

You can either wait for a thunderstorm event in nearly any of the regions, or head to the Stormtouched Highlands and wait to get struck by lightning. Once you have the Lightning-in-a-bottle, head back to the doctor.

Speak to him again, and he will ask you to put his head on the incomplete body on the examination table. Interact with the body to place the doctor's head on it, and then use the lighting-in-a-bottle on the nearby pylon. Once you interact with the nearby pylon, the doctor's head on the body will swap with the nearby chicken's head.

Speak to the doctor on the chicken's body to learn that he miscalculated. He will then give you your reward to distract you while he works out his tricky situation.

Congratulations! Quest complete!
quests.rewards:
• 1x zombie arm
  • Recipe to build a Lightning rod
