quests.name: Even More Restless Ghosts
quests.lead: Even More Restless Ghosts is a secondary quest where the player helps Zanik lay the ghosts of Fellhollow to rest. Players must collect the ghostspeak amulet from the well in Bramblemead, but completion of the first Restless Ghosts quest is not needed, just starting it.
quests.desc: Help Zanik lay some spirits to rest by finding them and completing their unfinished business.
quests.start: Speak to Zanik at Fellhollow.
quests.req:
• Restless Ghosts (Starting)
  • Withering Heights (partial completion - must disable all four god shrines)
quests.item_req:
• Clay decoration
  • mining equipment of power level 4 or higher (i.e., iron pickaxe or runes for Rocksplosion)
  • building materals for a square foundation, four walls, and a roof (e.g., 36 ash logs)
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • A ranged or magic weapon to kill rotsworn zombies
  • Food
  • Antipoison potions
quests.enemies: • Multiple zombies
quests.walkthrough:
Begin the quest by speaking with Zanik in Bleakfields Valley. She is located in the ruins to the east of Cathan at the three standing stones and north of a nearby spectral door.

Windswept ghost

Note: All four God Shrines must be activated to disable the barrier surrounding the village.

In Emberwood, travel to the ruin village previously surrounded by a magic barrier. In the outskirts of the village, near the north-east, are the ruins of a small home where the windswept ghost is located. Build a house consisting of any square foundation (under the ghost), four walls, and an enclosed roof around the windswept ghost. Talk to the windswept ghost again to complete the section. The door of the house must be closed for it to complete.

Reminiscing ghost

In Hope's Fall, travel to the ruin gates located north of the dragon spire. Speak with the reminiscing ghost and gift a Clay Decoration to complete the section.

Paint-spattered ghost

Between the Lake of Lost Souls and Coalridge Pass, just north-east of the most eastern area of the tainted river, lies the paint-spattered ghost. Talk to the ghost and it will describe the location of the sketchbook their husband took with him.

Travel north-east to a set of ruins that lie at the mouth of the cave. Enter the cave and clear a grouping of granite deposits atop a coal node to the left side to uncover a skeleton and the sketchbook. Interact with the sketchbook and then return to speak with the paint-spattered ghost again.

Finishing Up

Return to Zanik in Bleakfields Valley to finish the quest.

quests.name: The Wild Hunt
quests.lead: The Wild Hunt is a secondary quest from Vannaka within the region of Fellhollow. This quest introduces the player to a side story involving dying nature spirits due to the effects of Imaru's reign over Fellhollow and saving the remaining spirits with an unexpected yet welcomed twist.
quests.desc: Help Vannaka safeguard Fellhollow's nature spirits, by hunting them down in willow groves and collecting their hearts.
quests.start: Speak to Vannaka
quests.req: Partial completion of Withering Heights, to gain access to Fellhollow
quests.item_req: Three primordial hearts
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Food
quests.enemies: Three nature spirits
quests.walkthrough:
To begin this quest, speak to Vannaka who can be found west of Cathan's location in the Bleakfields Valley region of Fellhollow. He will explain to you how nature spirits are dying out due to the nature of this region and he tasks you to find nature spirits and defeat them to collect their primordial hearts. These spirits can only be found in Willow groves at or around the western area of Fellhollow and will look like white glowing terrorbirds.

If you aren't up to looking all over for them, you can find one near the northwestern area of the druid's circle in the Emberwood area, one in the Dragon's Run area, and another in the southern section of Witchwillow Range.

Once you have all three hearts, return to Vannaka who will then use an old garou ritual from before Kuldra's reign to imbue you with the essence of these spirits.

Congratulations! Quest complete!
quests.rewards:
• Access to a terrorbird mount (press the ALT key)
  • 50x soul fragments (for any extra hearts you have)
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Things That Go Boom In The Night
objectives: Hunt down Nature Spirits near Fellhollow's willow groves and bring three of their hearts to Vannaka.
Bring the hearts to Vannaka.

quests.name: Things That Go Boom In The Night
quests.lead: Things That Go Boom In The Night is a secondary quest in Fellhollow. This quest is a partial continuation of the side storyline of preserving the region of Fellhollow due to Imaru's reign by introducing a new spectral enemy to be found within the region and how the environment is reacting to the adventurer's presence.
quests.desc: Gather Spectral Chinchompa skulls so that Vannaka can help the land heal.
quests.start: Speak to Vannaka
quests.req:
• Partial completion of Withering Heights, to gain access to Fellhollow
  • Completion of The Wild Hunt
quests.item_req: Ten spectral chinchompa skulls
quests.rec:
• Good armour and weapons
  • Food
quests.enemies: Ten spectral chinchompas
quests.walkthrough:
To begin this quest, speak to Vannaka, who can be found west of Cathan's location in the Bleakfields Valley region of Fellhollow. Just like The Wild Hunt, he will explain how the spirits in the area continue to be in torment, and task you to hunt for ten spectral chinchompas and bring him ten of their skulls. You must attack and/or kill them as quickly as you can, or they will vanish. They are located across Fellhollow, within wooded areas and groves (like the nature spirits).

Best location to find them near Vannaka is;

  • South Emberwood's druid circle.
  • Witchwillow Range's willow tree grove.

There should be enough for you to kill and collect their skulls. But if you missed one or a few, they take up to 10 in-game days to spawn, so other locations are;

  • In another willow tree grove north of Hope's Fall.
  • West of Doric's camp, where the first statue is before entering the cave.
    • Another is further west, near the shore of the Lake of Lost Souls.
  • In the south-eastern wood of Silverthorn Keep
  • In another willow tree grove in Silverthorn Keep.
  • Most eastern part of Silverthorn Keep, where a purification pool is located when heading into the keep.

Once you have all ten skulls, he will thank you, believing with your help Fellhollow may know peace again.

Congratulations! Quest complete!

quests.name: Seeking Salvation
quests.lead: Seeking Salvation is a secondary quest where players help Doric search for more valuable relics.
quests.desc: Find the statues to gain entrance to the vault and uncover the secrets that lie within.
quests.start: Speak to Doric east of the Lake of Lost Souls, inside a cave.
quests.req: • Partial completion of Withering Heights, to gain access to Fellhollow
quests.item_req:
• 5 air runes to cast Windstep or resources to build foundations and stairs to certain statues
  • Iron pickaxe or better
  • Torch or the spell Fire Spirit (if too dark or in a cave)
quests.rec:
• Good armor and weapons
  • Food and water
quests.enemies:
• Zombies (Can appear outside of the vault)
  • Skeletons
  • Dragon wolves
  • Vault archon
  • Vault guardian hulk
  • Vault overlord
quests.walkthrough:
Starting off

The quest can be started by talking to Doric east of the Lake of Lost Souls, inside a cave ruin. He'll inform you that the vault door is sealed by magic and requires you to unlock it. To unlock it, look for four dragonkin statues; activate them to unlock the door.

  1. One statue is located outside the cave entrance, before entering the cave.
  2. A statue can be found south-west of Doric, behind the giant pillar. If it is too dark, bring out your torch for better lighting.
  3. One is located on the top of the pillar, directly west of Doric. You will require the Windstep spell or build some foundation and/or stairs.
  4. The final statue is located north-west of Doric; there will be some rot. Use Windstep or build some stairs at the location. There will be a cracked wall; you will need a pickaxe to break it.

Skekven Kara

Once you have located and activated all four statues, you can enter the Skekven Kara vault. Make sure to bring plenty of cooked food and drinks (such as clean water or infusions) as there are multiple enemies within.

Inside the Skekven Kara vault, proceed in the entry room to the central staircase. At the second highest level of the stairs, an opening in the wall south of the staircase can be reached by using Windstep. In this cavern, interact with the dragonkin statue to learn the secrets, which Doric can translate.
quests.rewards:
• 1 salve crystal
    • This also unlocks the permanent option to purchase more crystals from Death's Exchange for 25 soul fragments each.
  • The recipe to craft a salve amulet
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Doric's Quest

Bring the dwarven writing to Doric.
Find someone in Fellhollow that can translate dwarvish text.

quests.name: Doric's Quest
quests.lead: Doric's Quest is a secondary quest from Doric within the region of Fellhollow. To start this quest, you must have partially completed Withering Heights and completed Seeking Salvation.
quests.desc: Doric is looking for rare weapons in Fellhollow.
quests.start: Speak to Doric

  • Seeking Salvation

  • 1 necromancer staff

quests.walkthrough:
Speak to Doric after completing Seeking Salvation, he will requests that you collect several rare weapons from stories he believe originated from Fellhollow!

Undead Ranger's Bow

He'll first ask for the undead ranger's bow, enter the Skekven Kara vault and locate a dragonkin effigy. Once you found the recipe, craft the bow and return to Doric.

If you already own the item, you do not need to craft it, the item will be kept.

Necromancer's Staff

Next he'll ask for the necromancer's staff, which can be found in a dragonkin effigy in Vekchenven Kara. Once you found the recipe, craft the staff and return to Doric.

If you already own the item, you do not need to craft it, the item will be kept.

Shadow Sword

The final search will be the shadow sword, which the recipe can be found by killing Ulgo the Zogre. The recipe is a rare drop, so you might need to kill them more than once. They are located in a cave within Emberwood, Eastern side of Silverthorn Keep and in Vekchenven Kara as the vault's boss. Once you find the recipe, craft it and return to Doric.

If you already own the item, you do not need to craft it, the item will be kept.

Congratulations! Quest complete!

  • 1 Doric's superior smithing supplies.

Craft a Shadow Sword and bring it to Doric in Fellhollow. Doric believes a zogre has the recipe.
Craft a Necromancer's Staff and bring it to Doric in Fellhollow. Doric believes the recipe is in a vault somewhere.

quests.name: Letters for the Dead
quests.lead: Letters for the Dead is a secondary quest where Players can speak to Postie Pete to start it.
quests.desc: Postie Pete needs some help finding and delivering some stolen letters around Bleakfields Valley in Fellhollow.
quests.start: Speak to Postie Pete in the Forgotten Temple.
quests.req: Partial completion of Withering Heights
quests.item_req: None
quests.enemies: None
quests.walkthrough:
Lending a hand...

Speak to Postie Pete and select option 2 to talk about this quest. He will ask you (while making a bone pun) if you can help him with something. Accepting his question, Postie Pete will mention how, by RPDT standards, he made a big mistake by misplacing some posts. He will tell you that, as he looked in his bag, someone came by and nabbed three letters. This mysterious thief then fled into Fellhollow. He then tells you that, after taking a quick look, he noticed someone shifty near the little house just outside the entrance to Fellhollow. He will then ask you to take a look for him.

The Missing Postage

Walk slightly north-east of the entrance to Fellhollow (where you find Ravanna's third journal) and you will find a suspicious skeleton sitting down in a chair. Talk to it and you will find that they are animate in a similar manner to Postie Pete. They mention being bone idle for the moment and hating puns, but asks you what you want. You have the following options:

Click on option 3, the skeleton will reveal that they haven't gotten any letters. This little accidental reveal will give you more dialogue options.

From this point, the skeleton will continue to gaslight you. They will say that you had already mentioned it before (No, you didn't) and, thus, open up new dialogue options. Choose option 1 in this new dialogue and the gaslighting continues. By choosing option 1 one more time, the skeleton will concede the gaslighting fight and give you one of the letters. Take this letter to a nearby red deposit box northwest of Vannaka's camp in Bleakfields Valley and deliver it.

Upon delivering it, a dialogue box will open up to inform you that when you posted the letter, you found a strange leaf that appears to partially fade into the spirit realm. It will then hint to you going into a spectral door.

Note: This will make the Suspicious Skeleton turn into uninteractable scenery once you acquire the letter from them. The relevant postage deposit box will vanish upon closing out of the dialogue box.

The Spectral Postage

Head directly east of Cathan's location (at the standing stones) to a glowing wall torch with a letter mail satchel dangling down. Interact with it to acquire one of the missing letters. This letter will want you to deliver it to the standing stones in Bleakfields Valley. Immediately head towards Cathan's location and, before going up to see him, the red mail deposit box will be on the left side of the trail. Deliver the postage and a dialogue option will appear. It will tell you that you discovered a small patch of ghostly looking fluff and it looks like unspun wool. This will prompt you to look for the former owner.

The Wooly Letter

Find a ghostly sheep named "Shaun" to retrieve a ghostly letter. He will be almost directly west of where the last postage deposit box was. Upon receiving the letter, you must take the letter to Imaru's Tower. As there are plenty of Rotsworn undead here, you will need to be careful.

Upon arriving at Imaru's Tower, another red postage deposit box will be in front of her tower off to the right. When you deliver the letter you obtained from Shaun, you will then need to return to Postie Pete. When you choose the option to continue the quest, Pete will thank you to delivering the letters and introduce you to the numbskull who caused the problem in the first place. It turns out that said numbskull was, in fact, Postie Pete's sibling and junior RPDT employee Parcel Pete. While Parcel Pete wanted to help out, it bungled everything up. Postie Pete will inform you that, due to Parcel Pete's "help", he put him on report and filing his PIP. He will then give you a decorative item that, in the future, will enable you to render further aid to him delivering letters.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!
quests.rewards:
• 1x postbox: buildable crafting scenery.
  • Access to an expanding and repeatable activity.
objectives: Find and deliver letters for Postie Pete. 0/3
Find and deliver letters for Postie Pete. 1/3
Find and deliver letters for Postie Pete. 2/3
Return to Postie Pete.
Visit Postie Pete near the entrance to Fellhollow to begin searching for lost letters.

quests.name: What Remains is Written
quests.lead: What Remains is Written is a secondary quest in Fellhollow.
quests.desc: Find the stolen knowledge and return it to its owner. I'm sure nothing bad will happen because of it.
quests.start: Speak to Abraxus The Eternal in Coalridge Pass.
quests.req:
• Partial completion of Withering Heights for access to Fellhollow.
  • Partial completion of Restless Ghosts for the amulet.
quests.item_req:
• Necromancer's crown
  • Necromancer's robe top
  • Necromancer's robe bottom
  • Good food
  • Ghostspeak amulet
quests.enemies:
• Multiple Rotsworn
  • Multiple Skeleton Archers
  • Multiple Skeleton Warriors
  • Razlem, the Deranged
  • Ulgo the zogre
  • Blightscale
quests.walkthrough:
Ransacked!

Speak to Abraxus The Eternal in Coalridge Pass just north of the fork in the road while wearing the full necromancer's gear. He will assume, at least from your clothes, that you are an apprentice of his and will require your aid. He will introduce himself quite arrogantly that you stand in the presence of "Abraxus The Eternal, master of necromancy, Keeper of secrets, both occult and arcane" and inform you that locals have ransacked his library and his most precious tomes have been spread across the eastern sub-regions. He tasks you to find them and bring them back, but not to read any of them. He claims that your mind is too young and too limited to contain the dread secrets within.

Hunt For Knowledge Pt. I: Ancient Tomes

To find all of the books you need to return to Abraxus, you will need to look through every corner of the Silverthorn Keep region. Here is some books you can find:

  • The Pride of the Avernic
    • Located in the second level of Silverthorn Keep next to a archery target scene.
  • The Importance of Chaos
    • Located just north-west of the ominous gateway. It's lying on a small incline on the south side of a small tower amidst a gateway ruin (which can be seen on the map). It is on the south-western end of the ruin.
  • Aetheric Fundamentals, a Primordial Primer
    • Located across the stone bridge in Silverthorn Keep where you find the curse fragment. There is a green dragon spawn right next to this.
  • The Wrath of Baba Potterington
    • Located in a crumbled stone house near a nature grove north of the 'sil' of Silverthorn Keep on the map.
  • Leonard the Bound
    • Located north-west of the ominous gateway within the ruins that serve as the transition area between the Lake of Lost Souls and Silverthorn Keep areas. The book is on top of the western side of the gate, laying on a pedestal. There will be skeletal hoplites and archers in this area.

Once you have all of the books, return to and speak to Abraxus.

Hunt of Knowledge Pt. II: The Secret Scrolls

Donning your necromancer's gear, speak to Abraxus. He will be excited to see that you have retrieved his books and hopes you didn't peek at them, but there is more to uncover. He mentions how three of his scrolls were taken from him and how you must reclaim them. He will say that the first scroll was taken from him by Blightscale, a green dragon, and that you must make a lesson of her hubris. The second scroll was taken by Ulgo, a zogre, who can be found nearby. The last one to find was taken by a rival of his called Razlem, the Deranged.

  • Eventide - A New Spawn
    • Defeat Razlem, the Deranged. He wanders a small ruin directly east of the ominous gateway. You will find the scroll on top of a desk near him.
  • Coclear Malificarum
    • Defeat Ulgo the zogre in Coalridge Pass. It will be right next to the chest in his hoard. Ulgo is just north of the "Coalridge Pass" label on the map.
  • The Binding of Ib
    • Defeat Blightscale. Blightscale is a green dragon located at the south side of the cliffs leading up to the Silverthorn Keep, north-east of the ominous gateway. She is immediately past some willow trees and a small set of ruins. There is a spectral door in the small clearing where he's located. The scroll is found near some bones in the clearing.

Once you have all the scrolls, don your necromancer's gear and speak to Abraxus. He will commend you for your efforts and say that you have earned his respect, which no one has earned for centuries. He will then remark that he isn't foolish enough to believe you can be rewarded only with his respect, as he gives you something that may serve you well. He will then excuse himself to mail a pebble to an old friend of his and hopes that they accept it, so he can haunt them for a while, as he is tired of the view.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!
quests.rewards: • 1x Abraxus ring trinket item and recipe unlock.

quests.name: Mirror, Mirror
quests.lead: Mirror, Mirror is a secondary quest in Fellhollow where you must talk to the mirror to start the quest.
quests.desc: Help free a mysterious figure from their mirror prison.
quests.start: Speak to the mirror west of the Emberwood Village
quests.req: • Partial completion of Withering Heights for access to Fellhollow.
quests.item_req:
• 1 silver bar
  • 1 fine thread
  • 1 sacred oil
  • 6 soul fragment
  • Dragon blood
quests.rec: • Good armour and weapons
quests.enemies:
• Multiple undead
  • Either green dragons or dragon wolf
  • Multiple Garou
  • Multiple Goblins
quests.walkthrough:
A Mysterious Mirror...

To begin this quest, speak to the mirror west of the Emberwood Village past the green dragon. You will hear crying audio when you first approach them.

They will be surprised to see a real living person in Fellhollow since their imprisonment decades ago and recount how a terrible necromancer sealed them within the mirror. While this necromancer first taunted them with the ritual needed to release them, they claim it is simple to do and shouldn't take long. They will ask you to collect the required items for them to start the ritual.

For the ritual, they need some dragon blood, a copy of their spellbook found within Emberwood Village, and some spectral silver thread.

Note: You can kill the nearby green dragon or some dragon wolves for the dragon blood.

Part I: Reagent Collection

For the copy of their spellbook, go into Emberwood Village (you will need to either have gotten past this point in the Withering Heights quest or reactivated the statues on a new world) and find the destroyed windmill. Inside, you will find a bedraggled spellbook. Pick this up as you will need it.

For the spectral silver thread, you will need to go find Edna's skeleton within Dragon's Run. To find that, look for a crumbling stone house near a willow grove and a rundown gateway. Her skeleton will be sitting back to a corner on the right side. Interact with the skeleton and the spirit of Edna will inform you that, to make the spectral silver thread, you will need to bring them the following items:

  • 1 silver bar
  • 1 fine thread
  • 1 sacred oil
  • 6 soul fragments

Once you have all these items, bring them back to Edna. Once you hand over the ingredients, the skeleton will perform a series of gestures which will be too quick for you to follow with your eyes. After a moment, the skeleton will hand you the spectral silver thread and return to rest. Once that is done, head back to the mirror.

Part II: The Candles

Speak to the figure in the mirror once again, and they will be happy that you collected all of the reagents. While they will take them off your hands, they mention that you can press them up to the glass, and they will get them. Hand over the reagents, and they will remark about how, while they prepare the ritual on their side, they will need you to tether them back to your reality by rekindling their memories. The reason why is that, due to their age, they have too many memories and need to put some of them safely away. They left a few of their memories as memorial candles within each region they have visited and, for each candle lit, a memory will return to help anchor them into reality. The figure will give you a small piece of their soul to help ignite these memorial candles and, once each candle is lit, they will be to return.

This is where you will need to visit each region of Ashenfall to light the candles. On your map, the candle areas will be highlighted blue. Here is the list of each candle location within the regions:

  • Fellhollow: Right next to the mirror.
  • Ghornfell:
    • Fractured Plains: Next to a small lake south-south-east of Velgar's Rise. The lake will contain floating rune essence.
    • Stormtouched Highlands: A bit north-east of the garou castle at the edge of a cliff. It will be along the edge of the territory.
    • Bloodblight Swamp: West of the garou encampment leading towards the bloodwood tree.
  • Brynmoor:
    • Whispering Swamp: Next to a giant swamp tree on the third most western island from the vault.
    • Bramblemead Valley: South of the Crasorak Kara vault, atop the cliff and behind the rocks.

With the final memory candle lit, head back to the mirror.

Part III: A Week-long Ride

Speak to the figure in the mirror, and it will inform you that it will get started on the ritual, but their freedom will take roughly a week or so. While you could wait to see what happens, they inform you that you don't need to stick around that long. You have done everything needed to help free them from their reflective prison and give you a reward for your assistance.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!
quests.rewards: • 1x Ulv's longbow and the subsequent recipe
objectives: Gather dragon blood, spectral silver thread and a ritual spellbook and bring them back to the mirror.
Rekindle the memorial candles across Ashenfall.
Speak to the mirror.

quests.name: Biohazard
quests.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
quests.lead: Biohazard is a secondary quest found in Dowdun Reach.
quests.desc: Investigate the strange corruption afflicting the residents of Dowdun Reach.
quests.start: Speak to Zanik under The Approach, or collect a corrupted essence sample from corrupted ravens
quests.req: Partial completion of Black Knight's Fortress (quest) for access to Dowdun Reach
quests.item_req:
• 10 corrupted essence samples
  • Dragon blood
  • Unholy water (collected during the quest)
  • Twilight lily (collected during the quest)
quests.rec:
• Arrows or bolts
  • Good armour
quests.enemies:
• Various monsters within Dowdun Reach
  • Corrupted raven
quests.walkthrough:
Getting started

You can start this quest in one of two ways: speak to Zanik, who is beneath The Approach, or simply collect a corrupted essence sample from any corrupted raven in Dowdun Reach. Either way, Zanik will ask you to gather 10 corrupted essence samples from corrupted ravens scattered across the region. Refer to the map on the right for their locations.

The three ingredients

Once you return to Zanik with all 10 samples, she will ask you to gather three additional items: Dragon blood, unholy water, and a twilight lily.

  • Dragon blood: can be obtained by slaying any dragon in Dowdun Reach, or from a dragon wolf if you want to head back to Fellhollow and hunt easier enemies.
  • Twilight lily: found in The Lake, glowing blue in front of an anima tree. The Lake is just south-west of Zanik.
  • Unholy water: behind The Cathedral, near three Zamorakian acolytes, a mage of Zamorak, and two elite Black Knights. Look for a statue with water flowing from its hands. You do not need to fight any of the enemies here — you can sneak to the fountain south-west of them to collect it.

Finding the Source

Bring all three items back to Zanik. She will ask you to track down the source of the corruption.

Head to The Nexus and make your way to The Grand Hall. Use windstep to climb up to the roof (beware of a Black Knight sniper and a Black Knight guardian), and you'll find a corrupted chicken named Putrilius.

Complete the dialogue with Putrilius.

Returning to Zanik

Return to Zanik and tell her what you found on the roof of the Grand Hall. She thanks you for your help with investigating the corruption and rewards you for your efforts.

Quest Completed!
quests.rewards:
• 1x Zamorak cape (and its recipe)
  • 50x infernal fragments
    • You can collect this by trading 10 corrupted essence samples with Putrilius.

quests.name: Wanted!
quests.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
quests.lead: Wanted! is a secondary quest found in Dowdun Reach. It is the most immediately available side quest after players cross The Approach and reach the The Courtyard.
quests.desc: Hunt down the Beast Tamers
quests.start: Speak to Vannaka in Dowdun Reach.
quests.req: Partial completion of Black Knight's Fortress
quests.rec:
• Tier-appropriate armour and weapons
  • Food
quests.enemies:
• Summoner Flament + Delrom
  • Houndmaster Rexiton + Fido, Gnasher, Lurch, Rufus, and Tiny
  • Rat Master Skrexis + Boggs, Curly, Nosey, Patch, Pip, and Reek
quests.walkthrough:
Getting Started

Speak to Vannaka, who can be found by the tent in front of The Library shortly after entering Dowdun Reach. He explains that three Black Knights — the Rat Master, the Hound Master, and the Summoner — have each gained control over different demonic creatures, and asks you to retrieve their training journals.

Vannaka can provide background on each of the three beast tamers if you ask. The three targets can be tackled in any order. Each is a genuine combat encounter with multiple enemies, so come prepared.

The Rat Master

Head south-west from Vannaka to The Menagerie; you'll need to cross The Library and defeat the lesser blue dragon guarding the entrance to The Menagerie before making your way further. Rat Master Skrexis can be found on a ledge at the end of the lower path, surrounded by his hellrats. He was once a reclusive knight with terrible hygiene habits who attracted vermin wherever he went — the corruption has only deepened that bond.

Defeat him and his pack of hellrats. Once the area is clear, look for his journal sitting on a rock directly behind where he was standing, to the left of the statue. Interact with it to read or take some pages.

The Hound Master

Make your way to The Garrison and descend to the lower floors of the forward building. Philius Rexiton, the Hound Master, was a noble with a love for dogs before the corruption took hold. Now he commands a whole pack of hellhounds in the dungeons below.

This is a crowded fight — you'll be dealing with Rexiton and his entire pack at once. Try to manage the hellhounds while keeping pressure on the Hound Master himself. After defeating them, the journal is in the central kennel, lying on the table.

The Summoner

Head south from Vannaka to The Cathedral and descend into the crypts below. His quarters are immediately adjacent to The Lake, which is the closest nodestone. Lester Flament, the Summoner, wanders here with Delrom, his eerily loyal demon. Flament was reputedly odious and unpopular even among the Black Knights.

Delrom hits hard, so don't underestimate this fight. Once the Summoner is defeated, pick up his journal from the plinth at the back wall, below the demon gargoyle.

Returning to Vannaka

With all three journals in hand, return to Vannaka. He eagerly examines the journals, expecting to find dark rites and sinister spells — only to discover that the beast tamers' secret was treating the creatures kindly.

Vannaka hands you a trinket to help deal with demonic creatures, remarking that there's no time for the friendlier approach.
quests.rewards: • Corroded jewellery vestige, required to create the unholy symbol.

quests.name: What's Theirs is Mine!
quests.update: 0.11 is live now! Enter Dowdun Reach...
quests.lead: What's Theirs is Mine! is a secondary quest found in Dowdun Reach. It serves as the introduction to nodestones, the fast-travel network within the keep, and can be started by speaking to Doric in The Nexus.
quests.desc: Help Doric track down the mage that stole his keepsake, by unlocking portals around Dowdun Reach.
quests.start: Speak to Doric in The Nexus in Dowdun Reach.
quests.req: Partial completion of Black Knight's Fortress
quests.rec:
• Tier-appropriate armour and weapons
  • Food
quests.enemies:
• 2x shardbound lesser demon (at The Demon Gate)
  • Black Knight warriors, Black Knight guardians, and Mages of Zamorak (throughout)
quests.walkthrough:
Getting Started

Speak to Doric in The Nexus. He explains that a red-robed wizard barged into him and stole a small bronze dog on a keychain — a keepsake made by his son, Boric, and one of his most treasured possessions. The mage fled through one of the nearby portals, and Doric caught a brief glimpse of pews and religious fixtures before the thief vanished.

Doric asks you to chase the mage through the portals and recover his keepsake. He points out that following the trail should also help you activate the nodestones scattered around Dowdun Reach, opening up fast-travel routes through the keep.

The three locations can be visited in any order. Each is in hostile territory, so come prepared.

The Cathedral

Make your way to The Cathedral region in Dowdun Keep. The nodestone here sits on the north-west wing of the building and can't be reached from inside — enter the cathedral and turn right, then follow the outer walkway around the side. Look for a section where the parapets are missing and use Windstep to reach the upper ledge where the nodestone and notes are located.

The scrawled notes on a nearby table are incoherent ramblings about the nature of portal magic — the mage was studying how the nodestones in the keep work without runes, drawing power from the Dreaming Stone instead.

There's no sign of the mage himself, but the nearby nodestone crackles with lingering energy. Activate it and return to Doric.

Back at The Nexus, Doric reports that you just missed the mage — the red-robed wizard ran right past him again, waving a great spiky staff around "without fear of poking anyone's eyes out." This time the portal showed chains, cells, and angry-looking knights. A garrison, perhaps.

The Garrison

Head to The Garrison and make your way to the building with four turrets on the norther face of the fortress. Inside, look for the mage's schematics sitting atop a crate near the nodestone, on the first floor. These notes describe some form of emotion-based magic — an attempt to draw energy from suffering and channel it into a source of great pain.

Again, no mage in sight. Activate the nodestone and return to Doric.

Doric tells you the mage sprinted past him once more, and this time the portal showed glowing lights, water, and rock — some sort of sinister demonic gateway.

The Demon Gate

Travel to The Demon Gate, the underground area beneath Dowdun Keep. This is the one location where you'll face a proper fight: make your way through the area to the far end, past two shardbound lesser demons guarding an arena.

On the other side, you'll find the body of the Zamorak mage. The wounds are fresh — singed robes and claw marks raked across his torso. Whatever he was trying to accomplish with his portal magic and emotion-draining schematics, the demons got to him first.

Search the body. There's no sign of Doric's keepsake, but you do find a crumpled schematic of some kind. Take it and return to Doric.

Returning to Doric

Speak to Doric back in The Nexus. In a moment of sheepish honesty, he admits the mage never actually stole the bronze dog at all — when the wizard knocked into him, the keepsake fell out of his pocket and rolled behind a rock. The whole chase was a wild goose chase.

Feeling guilty, Doric examines the schematic you recovered from the dead mage. He identifies it as a design for some sort of sinister staff and, by way of apology, teaches you how to craft it — the Zamorak staff.

He also mentions that the nodestones seem like they'd be quite useful to have fully operational, and suggests you activate the rest of them around Dowdun Reach for an additional reward.

Bonus: Activating All Nodestones

If you activate all nine nodestones throughout Dowdun Reach and return to Doric, he'll congratulate you — then grumble about adventurers always expecting a reward. He hands over a portal reward pack containing tier 2 Artisan, Construction, Magic, and Mining experience tomes.
quests.rewards:
• 1x recipe for the Zamorak staff
  • 1x portal reward pack (for activating all nodestones):
    • 1x Tome of the Artisan - Vol 2.
    • 1x Tome of Construction - Vol 2.
    • 1x Tome of Magic - Vol 2.
    • 1x Tome of Mining - Vol 2.

quests.name: Contact!
quests.lead: Contact! is a secondary quest within Umbral Sands. You can start the quest by speaking with Avisk.
quests.desc: Work with Avisk to find a potential shortcut to Fuzan's Volcano
quests.start: Speak to the Avisk Crystal in Umbral Sands
quests.req: Partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper
quests.item_req:
• 1 Shovel
  • 1 Pickaxe
  • 4 Vault Shards
quests.rec: • Plenty of food/drink for keeping up thirst and hunger.
quests.walkthrough:
Speak to the Avisk crystal in Umbral Sands to start this quest.

Find defunct vault guardians, gather fragments of the crystal helix, and use them together to open a shortcut to Fuzan.

Speak to Vault Guardian Prime in a nearby cave, hints there are 3 crystal helix remains you have to gather.

Vault Guardian Prime Cave Entrance:

Vault Guardian Prime:

Damaged vault guardian

While still in the room with Vault Guardian Prime, Turn directly opposite of Vault Guardian Prime, follow the red lights through the tunnels, once you reach the big cave, the guardian remains will be on the left-hand side.

Damaged vault guardian entrance:

Damaged vault guardian location:

Dead vault guardian

This guardian is in the kalphite eggs outside and to the right of the cave entrance.

You will get a message saying that this Helix is missing and to locate the owner of the Footprints.

Speak to Zanik east of the kalphites at an oasis camp and she will give you the crystal helix in exchange for your help.

Buried vault guardian

Last guardian location is within a ruined building, you need a shovel to dig up the guardian. If you have 4 vault shards in your inventory, you can reactivate it and get the Helix.

Return to vault guardian Prime and hand over the crystal helix fragments. Use the crystal helix to pass through the magical barrier.

Speak to Zanik, break the Avisk crystals with a pickaxe, interact with each Vein of Consciousness, and then speak to Zanik once more.

Congratulations! Quest Completed.
quests.rewards: • Icthlarian fetish - a vestige for creating the pharaoh's sceptre.

quests.name: Brink of Extinction
quests.lead: Brink of Extinction is a secondary quest within the Umbral Sands. Players must speak with KotHaar-Hok-Zi in order to start the quest.
quests.desc: Help Zi to become a real KotHaar
quests.start: Speak to the Kot-Haar Zi in The Burning Spire
quests.req: Partial completion of Icthlarin's Little Helper
quests.item_req:
• 3 raw beltfish
  • Cactus steak
quests.rec: None
quests.enemies: KotHaar-Hok-Zi
quests.walkthrough:
Getting Started

Speak to Zi in Umbral Sands to start this quest. KotHaar-Zi is located in The Burning Spire, directly south-east of Sinking Pyramid on an 'L-shaped' island.

Protection from Scorch

KotHaar-Zi will inform you that their body was not made to survive Scorch and asks for assistance with adapting. They ask you to bring them 3 raw beltfish and 1 cactus steak.

"THE GAUNTLET OF FIRE!"

After returning to KotHaar-Zi, they will tell you about four pedestals, scattered around the Burning Spire area - giant black blocks with fire on top. They ask you to touch all four of them in any order and then return to KotHarr-Zi. A blue circle will be added to your map, showing the area the four pedestals are located at.

  • Pillar 1: Located east of the Sunken Pyramid, on top of a large rock structure.
  • Pillar 2: Located north of the Sunken Pyramid, behind KotHaar-Zi.
  • Pillar 3: Located west of the Sunken Pyramid.
  • Pillar 4: Located south of the Sunken Pyramid, south-west from KotHaar-Zi.

After interacting with all four pillars, return to KotHaar-Zi.

Cave of Screams

After talking to KotHaar-Zi, they will tell you they are heading to the Cave of Screams, which is located west of the Sunken Pyramid. At the entrance to the Cave of Screams, there will be a bouncer who will ask for a password.

Make your way to the Cave of Screams entrance, located in the top-left corner of The Burning Spire, directly right of the tree icon found on the map.

Talk to the KotHaar Bouncer. Pick any of the three dialogue options - it doesn't matter which you choose. After picking the third dialogue option, you will be given a KotHaar numbering for dummies scroll. Inspect the scroll in your quest inventory.

Talk to the Bouncer again and select the option which says "Two triangles separated by a line?".

You will now be able to access the Cave of Screams. The bouncer will warn you that KotHaar-Zi has changed, and that their core must be forged into a new body, a new body which is controlled by Fuzan.

Reforged Zi

Upon entering the Cave of Screams, you'll immediately be met by two hostile KotHaar-Xil and a hostile Reforged Zi. Defeat all three enemies. After Reforged Zi is defeated, Zi core will appear on the ground - grab it and then exit the cave.

Return to the Bouncer

Talk to the Bouncer. They will award you for assisting with Zi and reward you with the plate of pure obsidian, which unlocks recipe for obsidian cape.

Quest Completed!

quests.name: Statues of Saradomin
quests.lead: Statues of Saradomin is an activity that can be started in the Bramblemead Valley, east of Crasorak Kara.
quests.walkthrough:
The activity requires the player to find three statues of Saradomin and insert gemstones into them:

  1. Whispering Swamp: The statue is in the north-west corner of the swamp. The statue requires an opal to be inserted in exchange for the opal emblem
  2. Fractured Plains: The statue is in the central portion of the plains, east of the tower and west of a lake, on the lower side of a small cliff. The statue requires a jade to be inserted in exchange for the jade emblem
  3. Stormtouched Highlands: The statue is in the north-east portion of the highlands, along the cliff edge. The statue requires a sapphire to be inserted in exchange for the sapphire emblem.

Once all emblems are collected, return to the statue to receive a Saradominist cloak.

quests.name: Warding Off Danger
quests.lead: Warding Off Danger was a secondary quest, started after crafting armour for the first time.
quests.desc: The Wise Old Man wants to teach you about Lifewards and how to recharge them.
quests.start: Speak to the Wise Old Man, located north-east of the Bramblemead Valley ruins.
quests.req: Rune Mysteries
quests.item_req:
• 13 stones
  • 9 rune essences
quests.walkthrough:
Speak to the Wise Old Man; he wants to teach you about lifewards and how to recharge them. First, you will need to create a rune altar, requiring 12 stone and 4 rune essence. After you build the altar, create a small wardstone with 5 rune essence and one stone. It is recommended to make more (and possibly a higher-tier wardstone) for the next quest, Dragon Slayer.

After making the small wardstone, bring it to the Wise Old Man to complete this quest.
quests.rewards: • 2 small wardstones
quests.required:
This quest is required to complete the following quest(s):

  • Dragon Slayer

quests.name: Regicide
quests.lead: Regicide is the ninth primary quest, the fifth in the main storyline of RuneScape: Dragonwilds, and the final quest of Kuldra's Saga. In this quest, the player is able to enter the Scorned Wilderness to defeat Kuldra and stop her plans to rebuild the Harmonic Resonator to save Gielinor after slaying Fuzan and reuniting the Garou tribes of Umbral Sands.
quests.desc: Take the fight to Kuldra, and end this once and for all.
quests.start: Interact with the Dragon Gate north of the Fractured Plains.
quests.req: Icthlarin's Little Helper
quests.rec:
• Adamant or better Logging Axe
  • Rune or better Logging Axe (for the Magic Trees)
  • Adamant or better Pickaxe
  • Power level 7 or better armour and weapons
  • Antipoison potions for the poison areas.
  • Food and drinks
  • Strong Tea for long grinds through the raid.
quests.enemies:
• Multiple Zombies
  • Multiple Garou Berserkers
  • Multiple Garou Hunters
  • Garou Thanes
  • Multiple Goblin Warriors
  • Multiple Goblin Archers
  • Goblin Bruisers
  • Multiple Skeletal Warriors
  • Multiple Skeletal Archers
  • Multiple Putrid Rats
  • Plague Kings
  • Rat King
  • Abyssal Demon
  • Black Dragons
  • Kuldra
quests.walkthrough:
Part I: The Gate Opens

To start this quest, players must have completed Icthlarin's Little Helper. After that, head back into the Fractured Plains and head north-west of Velgar's Rise. You will soon come across a Dragon Gate that will take you into the Scorned Wilderness. Interact with the gate and it will tell you that the blood of the four seal the gate. It will then tell you that the lord of the skies has fallen, Xikotal slain by Kuldra, Velgar's cruelty no longer infects the earth, Imaru finally rests in peace, and Fuzan's flames have been extinguished. Choose the option to journey into the Scorned Wilderness.

Note: This will play the narrative trailer for the Scorned Wilderness.

Once you pass through the gate, the journey begins. Speak to Zilyana in Rasthin's Rest. She explains that she was sent there by Saradomin to deal with the threat, but requires your aid, as getting closer to Kuldra's lair weakens her. Zilyiana mentions that the location you are in makes a perfect base, it is advised that you build a new base here so that you can return after using a checkpoint, rest, craft and so on. After you have set up a base here, speak to Zilyana to continue to the first location.

Speak to Zilyana, and start the raid, you will be transported to Dragontail Vines.

Note: For a strategy guide, see Scorned Wilderness. You'll need to clear the raid in order to complete the quest.

Part II: Death of a Queen

After defeating Kuldra, Zilyana will transport you back to Rasthin's Rest, where she will inform you that due to the veil, their deeds will go unnoticed for now. You are rewarded for your help.

Congratulations! Quest Complete!
quests.rewards:
• 1x Regicide Reward Pack
    • 1x Dragon Kiteshield
    • 1x Dragonslayer's Cape
    • 1x Queenslayer's Reward Pack
  • Full access to the Scorned Wilderness raid, including Kuldra's Sanctum.
    • Each time you complete a run, you will be forced to start again in Dragontail Vines.
  • Lougrim's Staff
Additional rewards/activities

After the quest, players can take Lougrim's Staff into Umbral Sands and speak to Ancamairon - Alcarrid Elder to receive the Lougrim Memorial Shrine furniture reward.
