Velgar.name: Velgar
Velgar.respawn: With each new instance created using the challenge horn/rejoined.
Velgar.lead: General Velgar, also known as the Big High War God by the goblins after witnessing Bandos retreat from Velgar, is one of Queen Kuldra's generals and most feared disciples. His lair, Velgar's Rise, is located in the Fractured Plains.
Velgar.history:
Early Life

Velgar was originally one of many dragons bred and controlled by the dragonkin of Ashenfall. He specifically belonged to the dragonkin architect Brakka, who used him primarily as a beast of burden to haul materials for construction projects.

When conflict broke out between the alliance of humans and goblins against the garou, Velgar was finally permitted to join battle. He demonstrated exceptional brutality and combat prowess, decimating entire settlements and military units. During the conflict, Bandos took note of Velgar and challenged the dragon. Bandos, in his arrogance, attempted to wrestle Velgar to death, without wearing any armour, wielding any weapons, or using any protective wards. He nearly succeeded in killing Velgar, until Velgar called down a poison-filled rock from the skies that struck Bandos in the head. This caused him to release Velgar from his grip, which allowed Velgar to weaken Bandos with his anima-infused poison breath, after which the god retreated. His injury would permanently corrupt the region now known as Bloodblight Swamp, bleeding through the land itself. Despite his effectiveness in battle, Brakka returned Velgar to servitude after the conflict subsided, forcing him to haul construction materials once again. This treatment would later fuel Velgar's desire to rebel against the dragonkin.

When Kuldra began planning her rebellion against the dragonkin masters, Velgar was among the first to join her cause. Kuldra taught him to absorb power from Ashenfall's anima font, transforming him into a dragon infused with the power of earth itself. When Kuldra sent her dragons to destroy the human settlement, Velgar played a central role in the destruction of some settlements across Ashenfall. He led the assault on the Keep of Blue Flames and Bramblemead Village, with his forces burning everything in their path. He now rules over much of Ashenfall with the goblins as his followers and the garou as his subjects. He was once challenged by a garou king, who, despite being defeated, was respected and demanded his defeat to be celebrated in his honour.

Sixth Age

In the 13th year of the Sixth Age, when an expedition arrived from the mainland to explore the rediscovered continent of Ashenfall, Velgar and another personally attacked their ship for the Dragon Queen. His attack decimated the expedition, leaving only a handful of survivors, including Cathan, Dionysius, Vannaka, Zanik, and Doric. As the survivors made contact with the mainland, new adventurers would head the call, but some would meet an unfornate fate, by either Velgar, the goblins or garou. Some random Adventurer(s) would arrive to Ashenfall in hope to have a fresh start. While the adventurer(s) prepare themselves by setting up a base and gathering equipment, Cathan would go off on his own, recruiting goblins to his cause in helping him find a way to fight Velgar. Despite his best effort, Velgar witnessed Cathan get captured by the garou, who sacrificed the human in his name. Despite his constant attack against the adventurer(s), he was confronted by them and defeated. Putting a stop to his attack against them and his rule over both the Ghornfell and Brynmoor

Vulture.name: Vulture
Vulture.lead: Vulture are power level 1 birds found all over Umbral Sands.

Wild Jade Vine.name: Wild Jade Vine
Wild Jade Vine.lead: Wild jade vines are a type of enemy that can be found in the Bloodblight Swamp. Wild jade vines appear to be sentient, with the two "heads" (stalks) talking to each other before attacking.
Wild Jade Vine.attacks:
The jade vine has three attacks:

  • Root attack: The jade vine will send its roots at the player to stagger them.
  • Poison missile: Similar to the druid projectile, the jade vine will send a moderately tracking projectile at the player, damaging them by six hitpoints for five seconds. Players can only parry this attack.
  • Double stem slam: The jade vine will slam both of its "heads" into the ground, releasing a small poison cloud and damaging the player by six hitpoints for five seconds if it makes contact. Players can either block or parry the attack.

Strategy

Close the distance so that the plant only uses its double slam attack, which can be easily parried or blocked. Players can also attack the wild jade vine by attacking from 20–25 metres away with ranged or magic.
Wild Jade Vine.strategy: Close the distance so that the plant only uses its double slam attack, which can be easily parried or blocked. Players can also attack the wild jade vine by attacking from 20–25 metres away with ranged or magic.

Wild Lapulis Vine.name: Wild Lapulis Vine
Wild Lapulis Vine.lead: Wild lapulis vines can be found in the Stormtouched Highlands. They will remain inactive until a player is detected nearby; despite their affinity for shock magic, they can still be damaged by lightning strikes.
Wild Lapulis Vine.attacks:
• Double Head Slam: The Lapulis will slam both of its heads in the direction of the player. This will generate a small shock field, damage the player, and inflict the Shocked status effect if they do not dodge.
  • Shock Missile: The Lapulis will launch a projectile that will inflict the Shocked status effect and damage the player.
  • Root Attack: The Lapulis will send its roots underground to impale the player; dodge to avoid, this attack will stagger the player.

Strategy

Close the width on the vine so that the plant only uses its double slam attack, which can be easily parried or blocked. Players can also attack the vine by attacking from 20–25 metres away with ranged or magic.
Wild Lapulis Vine.strategy: Close the width on the vine so that the plant only uses its double slam attack, which can be easily parried or blocked. Players can also attack the vine by attacking from 20–25 metres away with ranged or magic.

Wild Ruby Vine.name: Wild Ruby Vine
Wild Ruby Vine.lead: This sentient plant is a version of the Wild Jade Vine, Rather than using water for sustenance, they use heat burning any prey they can capture for energy.

Wolf.name: Wolf
Wolf.lead: Wolves are power level 3 monsters. They often travel in packs of two or three (along with dire wolves), and can inflict the Bleed debuff.

Zamorakian Acolyte.name: Zamorakian Acolyte
Zamorakian Acolyte.lead: Zamorakian acolytes are power level 6 monsters located in Dowdun Reach. They are able to cast fire spell and attack with their daggers.

Zogre.name: Zogre
Zogre.location: Hope's Fall Vekchenven Kara Silverthorn Keep
Zogre.lead: Zogres are undead located in Fellhollow and Dowdun Reach. They drop zogre packs, corpse cotton, and the vestige for shadow sword. Zogres have an 8-day respawn delay after being killed.
Zogre.attacks:
• Belly Flop: The zogre will jump into the air and flop onto the ground.
  • Charge: After a short wind-up, the zogre will charge towards the player.
  • Rock Toss: The zogre picks up two rocks and throws them at the player in succession.
  • Swing Combo: The zogre swings twice at the player and then stomps on the ground with their foot.

Zombie.name: Zombie
Zombie.lead: Zombies are power level 5, 6 and 8 in Ashenfall located within the region of Fellhollow, Dowdun Reach and teh Scorned Wilderness raid. In Fellhollow, each zombie respawns an additional time to fight the player.

Zombie Cow.name: Zombie Cow
Zombie Cow.lead: Zombie cows are a power level 5 monster located in Fellhollow.
Zombie Cow.journal: Rotted and twisted, these cows have a terrible beef with the living!

Zombie Rat.name: Zombie Rat
Zombie Rat.lead: Zombie rats are power level 5 aggressive undead monsters, located in Fellhollow.
Zombie Rat.journal: And you thought the giant rats were bad enough!

animal hide.text: Animal hide is a basic item gathered from animals like cows, deer, and wolves. It can be put into the tannery to create leather.

animal bone.text: Animal bones can also be acquired using the Bark To Bones spell. It requires 10 nature runes and 10 earth runes to cast, and the spell must target a tree.

Animal bones are retrieved from killing animals such as cows, deer, and sheep. They can also be found on the ground in a cave in the Stormtouched Highlands. Players can also receive it by casting Bark To Bones on a tree. Upon receiving a bone for the first time, players can unlock the tannery and the stone range.

It may be beneficial for players to kill lost souls instead of rotsworn enemies because the beginning stages of being Soul Rifted include power level 2 lost souls spawning instead of power level 5 rotsworn skeletons, making it easier to receive ectoplasm.

gypsum.text: Gypsum is a basic Mining material mined from gypsum nodes, found scattered across the Umbral Sands.

harralander.text: Harralander is a herb that is harvested from Harralander plants, found primarily in the Whispering Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 6 garou chits.

iron ore.text: Iron ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from iron ore nodes, which are mainly found all over the Stormtouched Highlands and Fellhollow. Three ores can be smelted in a furnace into an iron bar, or three can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create a steel bar.

jade.text: Jade is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining iron ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be mined both manually with an appropriate pickaxe and by using the Rocksplosion spell.

limestone.text: Limestone is a basic Mining material mined from limestone rocks, found scattered across the Dowdun Reach region, typically beside bodies of water.

maple logs.text: Maple logs are obtained by chopping down maple trees, with a mithril logging axe or better.

maple sap.text: Maple sap is a Power Level 4 basic material, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into maple syrup starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt maple syrup at level 50. It can be gathered from chopped maple trees.

mithril ore.text: Mithril ore is a basic Mining material that can be mined from mithril ore nodes, which can be found all over the Dowdun Reach region and its underground areas. Three ores can be smelted along 3 pieces of coal in a blast furnace to produce mithril bars.

oak logs.text: Oak logs are obtained by chopping down oak trees, with a bronze axe or better.

onion seeds.text: Onion seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Onion seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild onion (plant).

potato.text: Potatoes are a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into baked potato starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt potato at level 27. They can be gathered from potato (plant)s in Bramblemead Valley and potato (Farming) from potato seeds. Potatoes can be used to make compost.

pumpkin.text: Pumpkins are a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into roast pumpkin starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt pumpkin at level 50. They can be gathered from pumpkin (plant)s in Fellhollow and Dowdun Reach and Farmed from Pumpkin (Farming) grown from pumpkin seeds. silver ore.text: Silver ore is a basic Mining material mined from silver ore nodes, which are mainly found in the Bloodblight Swamp. It can be smelted at a furnace to make silver bars.

red topaz.text: Red topaz is a gemstone that can be obtained by mining silver ore nodes. It can be found if the player has unlocked the Gem Prospector perk at level 16 Mining. It can be manually mined with an appropriate pickaxe or using the Rocksplosion spell.

snapdragon.text: Snapdragon is a herb that can be found by harvesting the Snapdragon plant in the Bloodblight Swamp or can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

snapdragon seeds.text: Snapdragon seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Snapdragon seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Snapdragon.

swamp weed.text: Swamp weed can be harvested by the swamp weed plant, which mostly spawns in and around the poisonous waters in the Bloodblight Swamp and inside the Kletterbuja Kara vault. It can be used to create swamp thread.

swamp weed seeds.text: Swamp weed seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Swamp weed seeds can be used to grow swamp weed in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in oak farming plot. Planting swamp weed seeds in a farming plot will yield 5 experience in Farming. Swamp weed seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild Swamp Weed.

irit.text: Irits are herbs acquired from destroying thorny irit roots and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 18 garou chits.

tin ore.text: Tin ore is a basic Mining material mined from tin ore nodes, which can are mainly found in the Fractured Plains. It can be smelted at a furnace along with Copper to produce bronze bars.

toadflax.text: Toadflax is found by harvesting the Toadflax plants in the Bloodblight Swamp and can be bought from Domri - The Merchant for 12 garou chits.

toadflax seeds.text: Toadflax seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Toadflax seeds can be obtained from harvesting wild toadflax (plant).

willow logs.text: Willow logs are obtained by chopping down willow trees. An iron logging axe (or better) is required to chop down willow trees.

yew logs.text: Yew logs are obtained by chopping down yew trees, with a adamant logging axe or better.

dihydrogen monoxide.text: Dihydrogen monoxide is a basic item that can be bought from Umbral Sands merchants for 25 garou chit. Unlike most drinks, this cannot be consumed.

garou weave.text: Garou weave can be bought from the merchants Iasadair, Beartach and Domri or found in chests in Umbral Sands and is primarily used for power level 7 armour.

tea leaves.text: Tea leaves is a basic item bought from merchants for 20 garou chits or found in chests in Umbral Sands . It can be processed into dried tea leaves at the kiln.

tastefully torn tights.text: Tastefully torn tights is a power level 5 vestige that can be purchased with 350 soul fragments at Death's Exchange. Players will need to study this to receive the recipe for the ranger tights.

remnants of a rotting robe.text: The remnants of a rotting robe is a vestige that unlocks the necromancer's robe top. It is obtained from Death's Exchange for 400 soul fragments.

sigil of a phoenix.text: The sigil of a phoenix is a vestige that unlocks the ring of life upon studying the recipe. It can be purchased from Death's Exchange in the Forgotten Temple under Fellhollow for 800 soul fragments.

salve crystal.text: A salve crystal is a piece of crystal from the mainland of Gielinor that is known to have properties against undead. It is given to the players by Doric as a reward when completing Seeking Salvation. This crystal is required for the creation of the salve amulet. Players can obtain more by buying it from Death after Seeking Salvation is completed.

anima-infused bark.text: Anima-infused bark is a basic crafting item that is required to create wild anima. Anima bark can be found on the ground around the anima trees and certain crystal trees located throughout the Fractured Plains biome. Players can interact with the item by picking it up, receiving 7 Woodcutting experience. Anima-infused bark can respawn after 72 minutes.

wheat.text: Wheat is a power level 2 raw ingredient. It can be harvested from wheat (farming) after it has fully grown. Wheat seeds can be used in a farming plot to grow the source plant.

watermelon.text: Watermelons are a consumable food item that provides 15 sustenance. They are also a Power Level 4 resource, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into watermelon jerky starting at Cooking level 41, and not be burnt into burnt watermelon at level 50. abraxus ring.text: The Abraxus ring is a ring that is a quest reward for completing the What Remains is Written secondary quest. Additional copies can be crafted from a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring has a chance to reduce the rune cost of utility spells when cast.

ava's accumulator.text: Ava's accumulator is an armour item equipped in the cape slot. It is a reward from Animal Magnetism, and additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest. Ava's accumulator adds a 10% chance of recovering arrows when worn.

black desert cape.text: The black desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the black memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

bloodblight cape.text: The Bloodblight cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Bloodblight Cape Pattern, found in a chest behind a broken wall in the Bloodblight Castle.

blue adventurer's cape.text: The adventurer's cape is a cape that requires no materials to craft. The recipe to craft the cape can be obtained by purchasing it from Death for soul fragments. When making the cape, there are options for several colour variants, those being: Blue, Red, Yellow, Purple, Green, Black, Orange, Pink, and White.

blue desert cape.text: The blue desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the blue memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

blue hex cape.text: The blue hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

bramblemead cape.text: The Bramblemead cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Bramblemead Cape Pattern, found in a chest atop the Runecrafting Guild. Using only Windstep to reach the chest is considerably difficult, it is recommended to do this in combination with building foundations.

chef's hat.text: The chef's hat is a power level 1 headwear whose recipe is obtained when a player reaches level 40 Cooking and obtains the perk Yes, chef!.

dowdun reach cape.text: The Dowdun Reach cape is a cape that can be created by learning the vestige found in a chest in Dowdun Reach. The gilded version can be unlocked by reaching the gold time for Tower Climb.

fellhollow cape.text: The Fellhollow cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Fell Cape Pattern, found in a chest buried under a pile of Rocks along the spine of the dragon skeleton, south of Imaru's Tower.

fire cape.text: The fire cape is a cape awarded after beating the Fight Cave activity. It is the only cape in the game that is dropped by a boss monster. When worn by the player it gives the Burning Endurance effect.

fractured cape.text: The fractured cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the PATTERN: fractured cape, found in a chest at the north-north-east tip of the Fractured Plains.

garou highborn's cloak.text: The garou highborn's cloak is a unique cape given as a reward by Vannaka for completing the Dog Days quest. Additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

goblin war banner.text: The goblin war banner cape is a unique cape given as a reward by Zanik for completing the Goblin Diplomacy quest. Additional ones can also be crafted via the Armour Bench after the quest.

green desert cape.text: The green desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the green memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

green dyad cape.text: The green dyad cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

green hex cape.text: The green hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

leggings of lightness.text: The leggings of lightness are a piece of power level 1 leg armour, which can be crafted using a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the suspiciously light tattered boots vestige, found in a chest atop the windmill in Temple Woods. Their special effect increases the player's maximum carry weight by 50 and reduces the amount of fall damage the player takes.

obsidian cape.text: The obsidian cape is a simple yet stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the plate of pure obsidian vestige, which is a reward for completing the quest Brink of Extinction.

orange desert cape.text: The orange desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the orange memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

paladin platelegs.text: Paladin platelegs are a power level 4 armour that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is obtained from Takla Kara, a dragonkin vault.

paladin's helm.text: The Paladin's helm is a power level 4 helmet that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is obtained from Takla Kara, a dragonkin vault.

paladin's platebody.text: Paladin's platebody is a power level 4 platebody that can be created at an armour bench. The recipe is obtained from Takla Kara, a dragonkin vault.

pioneer's cape.text: The pioneer's cape is a cape that requires no materials to craft. Its recipe is given to Early Adopters who purchased the game during Early Access.

pioneer's scarf.text: The pioneer's scarf is a decorative piece of Ranged Armour, who's recipe is given to Early Adopters who purchased the game during Early Access. It provides no defensive stats and costs nothing to make at a crafting table, but still counts towards the set effect like all other pieces of Ranged armour.

purple desert cape.text: The purple desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the purple memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

ravanna's ring.text: Ravanna's ring is a ring that is a quest reward for completing the A Melody Remembered secondary quest. Additional copies can be crafted from a jeweler's bench. While equipped, the ring has a chance to spawn a corpse cotton plant where enemies were slain.

red dyad cape.text: The red dyad cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

red hex cape.text: The red hex cape is a stylish cape that can be created by learning the vestige bought from Postie Pete in Evil Emporium.

saradominist cloak.text: The Saradominist cloak is a reward item from completing the activity, Statues of Saradomin. Like other capes, this shares the same melee, ranged, and magic defence.

whispering cape.text: The whispering cape is a craftable armour piece. The recipe is unlocked by acquiring the Whispering Cape Pattern, found in a chest near the waterfall in the Whispering Swamp.

white desert cape.text: The white desert cape is a stylish cape that takes no materials to craft. The recipe is unlocked after studying the white memory of Menaphos vestige, which can be found in chests in Umbral Sands.

agility flag.text: Agility flags are a reward for completing the Thunder Assault Agility course at silver or gold tier and can be built by the player. To build it, players must have at least 1 oak log, 1 padded cloth, and 1 warped feather.

imbuing barrel.text: The imbuing barrel is a facility used to slowly process potions into super potions. It requires wild anima to operate, which can primarily be obtained by smelting 4 anima-infused bark in the kiln. 1 wild anima will process 6 potions in 12 minutes. black knight warrior.text: The Black Knight warriors are power level 6 monsters found within Dowdun Reach. They are members of the Black Knights within Dowdun Reach and resides in the Black Knight's Fortress.

maple tree.text: Maple trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and a type of tree found in Dowdun Reach, which require a mithril logging axe (or better) to cut.

metal salvage.text: Metal salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

misc. salvage.text: Misc. salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

noxious draconic visage.text: The noxious draconic visage is an award obtained from the Wise Old Man in exchange for Velgar's head, which is obtained by killing Velgar during or after the quest Dragon Slayer. It can be used to upgrade the anti-dragon shield into the dragonblight shield.

oak tree.text: Oak trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and can be identified by different coloured leaves and darker bark than ash trees. Oak trees are located all over Brynmoor and Ghornfell. They can be chopped down using a bronze logging axe or better. Players will receive 28 oak logs in total upon chopping the entire tree and the stump.

plant salvage.text: Plant salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

potion salvage.text: Potion salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

raven.text: Ravens are power level 1 birds found all over Dowdun Reach.

rune essence geyser.text: Rune essence geysers are resource nodes that can be found in multiple regions across Ashenfall. They hold multiple rune essence rocks that lie around them, and have at most three rune essence rocks float above the geysers. The floating rune essence rocks can be shot down by using magic weapon attacks, or a ranged weapon. They can also be harvested by casting Rocksplosion at them, which both the fl

stone boulder.text: Stone boulders are Mining resource nodes that can be found throughout Ashenfall and inside vaults, and can be mined with any pickaxe. Stone boulders respawn after two in-game days, as long as the player is at least 100 metres away, and their built objects are not directly on the node's spawn area.

textile salvage.text: Textile salvage are a type of salvage hotspot that can be looted to obtain various resources. They can be found in Dowdun Reach.

thorny irit root.text: Thorny irit root requires a steel logging axe to fell. Thorny irit roots can be found in the town of Emberwood, near the surrounding larger lake, in and near the ruined buildings.

tome of mining - vol 2.text: Tome of Mining - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Mining experience.

tome of the titan.text: The Tome of the Titan is a reward from completing the Black Knight's Fortress quest.

torn tapestry.text: The torn tapestry is a vestige that is found in a buried chest in Dowdun Reach. Upon studying the vestige, players can create the Dowdun Reach cape.

willow tree.text: Willow trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and a type of tree found in Fellhollow, growing in areas known as 'willow groves', which require an iron logging axe (or better) to cut.

dragon slayer reward pack.text: A Dragon Slayer reward pack is a reward from completing two sections of the Dragon Slayer quest, Lost Adventurer and Fight for your Life. Players who open the pack will receive three harralander, three redberries, and three clay after completing Lost Adventurer, and players who open the second pack will receive one anti-dragon shield, one noxious draconic visage, and one Tome of the Dragon Slayer.

A Dragon Slayer reward pack is a reward from completing two sections of the Dragon Slayer quest, Lost Adventurer and Fight for your Life. Players who open the pack will receive three harralander, three redberries, and three clay after completing Lost Adventurer, and players who open the second pack will receive one anti-dragon shield, one noxious draconic visage, and one Tome of the Dragon Slayer.

restless ghosts reward pack.text: A Restless Ghosts reward pack is a quest reward after completing Restless Ghosts. Upon opening the pack, players will receive a volume-one variant of the Tome of Cooking, Tome of Woodcutting, Tome of the Artisan, and Tome of Mining.

reward pack: brynmoor bronze.text: Reward pack: Brynmoor bronze is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Brynmoor Agility course, Chasm Dash.

reward pack: brynmoor gold.text: Reward pack: Brynmoor gold is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Brynmoor Agility course, Chasm Dash.

reward pack: brynmoor silver.text: Reward pack: Brynmoor silver is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Brynmoor Agility course, Chasm Dash.

reward pack: dowdun reach bronze.text: Reward pack: Dowdun Reach bronze is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Dowdun Reach Agility course, Tower Climb.

reward pack: dowdun reach gold.text: Reward pack: Dowdun Reach gold is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Dowdun Reach Agility course, Tower Climb.

reward pack: dowdun reach silver.text: Reward pack: Dowdun Reach silver is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Dowdun Reach Agility course, Tower Climb.

reward pack: fellhollow bronze.text: Reward pack: Fellhollow bronze is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Fellhollow Agility course, Grave Run.

reward pack: fellhollow gold.text: Reward pack: Fellhollow gold is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Fellhollow Agility course, Grave Run.

reward pack: fellhollow silver.text: Reward pack: Fellhollow silver is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Fellhollow Agility course, Grave Run.

reward pack: ghornfell bronze.text: Reward pack: Ghornfell bronze is a reward for completing either the Fractured Ruins or the Thunder Assault Agility course in Ghornfell.
Reward pack: Ghornfell bronze is a reward for completing either the Fractured Ruins or the Thunder Assault Agility course in Ghornfell.

reward pack: ghornfell gold.text: Reward pack: Ghornfell gold is a reward for completing either the Fractured Ruins or the Thunder Assault Agility course in Ghornfell.
Reward pack: Ghornfell gold is a reward for completing either the Fractured Ruins or the Thunder Assault Agility course in Ghornfell.

reward pack: ghornfell silver.text: Reward pack: Ghornfell silver is a reward for completing either the Fractured Ruins or the Thunder Assault Agility course in Ghornfell.
Reward pack: Ghornfell silver is a reward for completing either the Fractured Ruins or the Thunder Assault Agility course in Ghornfell.

reward pack: umbral sands bronze.text: Reward pack: Umbral Sands bronze is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Umbral Sands Agility course, Lava Fields.

reward pack: umbral sands gold.text: Reward pack: Umbral Sands gold is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Umbral Sands Agility course, Lava Fields.

reward pack: umbral sands silver.text: Reward pack: Umbral Sands silver is an Agility reward pack for finishing the Umbral Sands Agility course, Lava Fields.

tome of agility - vol 1.text: Tome of Agility - Vol 1 is a skill tome that can be occasionally obtained through normal gameplay. When read, the tome gives 100 Agility experience.

tome of agility - vol 2.text: Tome of Agility - Vol 2 is a skill tome that can be found occasionally through gameplay. When read, the tome gives 400 Agility experience.

tome of attack - vol 2.text: Tome of Attack - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Attack experience.

tome of construction - vol 2.text: Tome of Construction - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Construction experience.

tome of cooking - vol 2.text: Tome of Cooking - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Cooking experience.

tome of magic - vol 2.text: Tome of Magic - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Magic experience.

tome of ranged - vol 2.text: Tome of Ranged - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Ranged experience.

tome of runecrafting - vol 1.text: Tome of Runecrafting - Vol 1 is a skill tome that is the reward given after completing the First Steps quest. It can also be received occasionally from chests. When read, the tome gives 100 Runecrafting experience.

tome of runecrafting - vol 2.text: Tome of Runecrafting - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Runecrafting experience.

tome of the artisan - vol 2.text: Tome of the Artisan - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Artisan experience.

tome of volcano.text: The Tome of Volcano is an item given to the player upon opening the Icthlarin's Little Helper reward pack. It gives the player +750 experience in the Attack, Magic, and Ranged skills.

tome of woodcutting - vol 1.text: Tome of Woodcutting - Vol 1 is a skill tome that is one of four rewards given after completing the Restless Ghosts quest and is a reward after the Rune Mysteries quest. It can also be received occasionally from chests. When read, the tome gives 100 Woodcutting experience.

tome of woodcutting - vol 2.text: Tome of Woodcutting - Vol 2 is a skill tome found in chests within Fellhollow. When read, the tome gives 400 Woodcutting experience.

withering heights reward pack.text: A Withering Heights reward pack is a reward from completing the Withering Heights quest. Players who open the pack will receive one dragoncurse shield, one undead draconic visage, and one Tome of the Undying.

aetheric fundamentals, a primordial prim.text: Aetheric Fundamentals a Primordial Primer is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. This book is found at the top level of Silverthorn Keep behind the green dragon and to the right of the curse seal from Withering Heights.

bandosian amulet.text: Bandosian amulet is a quest item for Goblin Diplomacy. It is one of two amulets, found in a reliquary in some Bramblemead ruins, while the other is found on a garou druid in the Whispering Swamp caves.

beast-training notes.text:
Beast-training notes are Notes collected from the three Targets Rat Master Skrexis, Houndmaster Rexiton and Summoner Flament for the quest Wanted!.
Hand them in to Vannaka for your reward!

bedraggled spellbook.text: The bedraggled spellbook is a quest item that is found during the Mirror, Mirror quest. Players will need to return this book to Edna as well as 1 silver bar, 1 fine thread, 1 sacred oil, and 6 soul fragments.

black knight's fortress reward pack.text: The Black Knight's Fortress reward pack is a reward for completing the Black Knight's Fortress quest, containing the Tome of the Titan and Titan's Wrath.

bundle of undead twigs.text: A bundle of undead twigs is a quest item obtained during the quest Animal Magnetism. The item acquired upon interacting with the "red" undead tree in the middle of Bloodblight Swamp, near the abyssal demon.

coclear malificarum.text: Coclear Malificarum is a quest item obtained on the ground by Ulgo the zogre. It is slightly north-west of the chest, by the large bones. It is one of three scrolls required to complete What Remains is Written. It is located in the north-east section of Coalridge Pass.

crystal seed.text: A crystal seed is a quest item found upon searching the first memorial stone in the quest, Heartstrings.

druid's bandosian amulet.text: Druid's Bandosian amulet is a quest item for Goblin Diplomacy. It is one of two amulets; the other amulet is found in a reliquary at Bramblemead ruins.

dust-covered sketchbook.text: The dust-covered sketchbook is a quest item that is found at Coalridge Pass, south-east of the ridge of the map. To access this sketchbook, players will need to avoid two skeleton monsters (one skeletal hoplite and one skeletal warrior) from attacking them outside the entrance. The entrance has a nearby rune essence geyser with ruined pillars and beams, and contains several coal nodes.

empty vial.text: Empty Vial is a quest item that is obtained by Doctor Fenkenstrain in The Great Body Robbery. Players will need to be struck by lightning with this in their inventory to convert it into a lightning-in-a-bottle.

eventide - a new spawn.text: Eventide - A New Spawn is a quest item obtained on the desk in the ruins by Razlem, the Deranged. It is one of three scrolls required to complete What Remains is Written. The scroll located in the very south-eastern part of Silverthorn Keep.

ghostspeak amulet.text: The ghostspeak amulet is a quest item that is required to speak with the restless spirits that appear around the map during the night, during the quest, Restless Ghosts. The amulet can be found by interacting with a crumbling well in the ruins of the town of Brynmoor in Bramblemead Valley, near where the Wise Old Man can be found.

glass owl.text: The glass owl is an item used in the Black Knight's Fortress quest. The glass owl is obtained by digging the grave west of the blue dragon spawn in the west of the Library region.

jade emblem.text: A jade emblem is a quest item used in Statues of Saradomin. This emblem is found near the centre of Fractured Plains.

letter.text: The letter is a quest item obtained by interacting with the postbox. It was introduced to the game in Update 0.10.2. Once acquired, players must deliver it to the specific address listed in the item's description; successfully completing the delivery allows the item to be exchanged for small rewards.

lightning-in-a-bottle.text: Lightning-in-a-bottle is a quest item that is obtained by getting struck by lightning with an empty vial in their inventory. Players will need this for The Great Body Robbery to provide life to Doctor Fenkenstrain's creation.

moonstone.text: Moonstone is an quest item found as an interactable object under select gypsum nodes. The item is relevant to the quest Icthlarin's Little Helper as Domri asks you to look for them under some gypsum nodes.

opal emblem.text: An opal emblem is a quest item used in Statues of Saradomin. This emblem is found at the western side of the Whispering Swamp.

portal reward pack.text: A portal reward pack is a reward for completing the quest, What's Theirs is Mine!, containing the following:

sapphire emblem.text: A sapphire emblem is a quest item used in Statues of Saradomin. This emblem is found at the north-eastern side of the Stormtouched Highlands.

saradomin symbol.text: The Saradomin symbol is an item found during the Withering Heights quest and is used to repair the Saradomin altar, which is one of the 4 altars holding up the barrier around Emberwood Village. It is located in the water just below the altar, propped up against a rock.

scarecrow's key.text: A scarecrow's key is found in Ghornfell, where players will need this when scarecrow scavenging.

spectral chinchompa skull.text: A spectral chinchompa skull is a quest item dropped by spectral chinchompa during the Things That Go Boom In The Night. Ten must be collected and handed to Vannaka to complete the quest.

spectral silver thread.text: Spectral silver thread is a quest item that is found after giving Edna 1 silver bar, 1 fine thread, 1 sacred oil, and 6 soul fragments, as well as the bedraggled spellbook to her during the quest, Mirror, Mirror.

Spectral silver thread is a quest item that is found after giving Edna 1 silver bar, 1 fine thread, 1 sacred oil, and 6 soul fragments, as well as the bedraggled spellbook to her during the quest, Mirror, Mirror.

the binding of ib.text: The Binding of Ib is a quest item obtained behind Blightscale. It is one of three scrolls required to complete What Remains is Written. The scroll located in the eastern part of Silverthorn Keep, below the cliffs by large bones.

the importance of chaos.text: The Importance of Chaos is one of the five tomes in What Remains is Written. It is obtained north of the ominous gateway leading to Dowdun Reach. It's lying on a small incline on the south side of a small tower amidst a gateway ruin. It is on the south-western end of the ruin.

the wrath of baba potterington.text: The Wrath of Baba Potterington is one of five books in in the quest What Remains is Written that players must find to return to Abraxus The Eternal. The book is found in the crumbled stone house near a nature grove north of the 'sil' of Silverthorn Keepon the map. There is a chest nearby, slightly to the north.

a corroded serrated blade.text: The vestige is only guaranteed if opening the chest located north of the Crystalline Mesa.
A corroded serrated blade is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the chieftain's blade. This vestige is found by the chest near the Heartstrings' starting tree.

an educational blade.text: The vestige is only guaranteed if opening the chest located on the eastern side of the Temple of Saradomin.
An educational blade is a vestige that unlocks the creation of the wooden training sword. This is found on the eastern side of the Temple of Saradomin roof.

a simple broken bow.text: The vestige is only guaranteed when opening the chest inside Finn's cave, located south-east of the Temple Woods (see the map above).

a threadbare grain sack.text: The vestige is only guaranteed if opening the chest located at the centre of Bramblemead Village.

azure metal contraption.text: Players are guaranteed the vestige drop when opening a specific chest (mentioned above) in Fractured Plains.

Azure metal contraption is a consumable item that unlocks the creation of Blurite Crossbow Limbs, the blurite crossbow, and blurite bolts. This is found in a chest, located under a cliff near the northern border of the Fractured Plains, west of the main river. black memory of menaphos.text: The black memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the black desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

corroded curved blade.text: The corroded curved blade is a vestige that unlocks the keris weapon. This vestige can be found in a chest after the Kalphite Queen boss fight in the south-western vault found within Umbral Sands.

green memory of menaphos.text: The green memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the green desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

orange memory of menaphos.text: The orange memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the orange desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

parts of a sinister looking staff.text: The vestige is only guaranteed if opening the chest located north-west of the Skeklac Kara's outside entrance.
Parts of a sinister-looking staff is a vestige that unlocks creation of the draconic staff. This is found in a chest, located north-west of the Skeklac Kara vault's entrance.

pink memory of menaphos.text: The pink memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the pink desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

plate of pure obsidian.text: The plate of pure obsidian is a vestige that unlocks the obsidian cape. It's a reward for completing the quest Brink of Extinction.

purple memory of menaphos.text: The purple memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the Purple Desert Cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

rotten farming tool.text: The rotten farming tool is a vestige found by looting Buried Chests in Fellhollow. There is a 5/100 chance for a buried chest to contain the vestige. It can be studied to unlock the undead spade recipe.

scratchy sackcloth.text: Scratchy sackcloth is a vestige used to unlock the shroud of Noggin. It can be obtained from the buried chest at the end of X Marks the Spot.

suspiciously light tattered boots.text: The vestige is only guaranteed when opening the chest located at the top of the windmill.

white memory of menaphos.text: The white memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the white desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

yellow memory of menaphos.text: The yellow memory of Menaphos is a vestige that unlocks the yellow desert cape and can be found in chests throughout Umbral Sands.

amylase crystal.text: Amylase crystal can be obtained by opening Agility course reward packs. It is used in making stamina potions.

avantoe.text: Avantoe is an herb obtained by harvesting Avantoe plants. It can be farmed by planting avantoe seeds in a willow farming plot, with iron secateurs providing an increased yield when harvesting.

black metal scraps.text: Black metal scraps is dropped from Black Knights. Six scraps can be combined with three coal in a blast furnace to create one black metal bar. Alternatively, players can create different coloured chandeliers and torches.

bloodwood sap.text: Bloodwood sap can be found by logging the red formations on the bloodwood tree in the southernmost area of the Bloodblight Swamp, that is located in the middle of a garou camp.

bronze leaf.text: Bronze leaves are a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions or create bronze bars. To obtain these, players must either collect them from bronze (or better) reward packs or recycle bronze bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

elder curiosities.text: Elder curiosities is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

emerald.text: Emeralds are a gemstone. They currently cannot be legitimately obtained.

garou artifact.text: Garou artifact is an item found in Umbral Sands. It can be sold to the merchants Domri, Beartach and Iasadair for 500 garou chits. Garou artifact can also be used to craft Lunar Robes.

garou chit.text: Garou chit can be found inside chests within the Umbral Sands region as well as from selling items to a garou merchant. Only a few items can be sold for chit, and the three available merchants have separate lists for what they will purchase from the player.

gold leaf.text: Gold leaf is a craftable item reward from various Agility courses that allows the player to make potions, golden regional capes, and a gilded version of the gyrhawk amulet. To obtain these, players must either collect them from golden reward packs or recycle gold bars at the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

kwuarm.text: Kwuarm is a herb that must be farmed using kwuarm seeds found in Goblin, Garou, or skeleton packs.

kwuarm seeds.text: Kwuarm seeds are a type of Ghornfell seed, used in the Farming skill. Kwuarm seeds can be obtained from a skeleton or garou pack, after discovering ash logs. When planted with the Farming skill, kwuarm seeds will grow into kwuarm.

mystic fibres.text: Mystic fibres are found by opening Zamorakian mage pack and are used to create mystic thread.

naphtha.text: Naptha is an item that is unlocked at level 45 Ranged, where players can use naptha to create fire oil. It is also dropped by dragon wolves.

obsidian device.text: Obsidian device is a basic item obtained from kot packs dropped by KotHaar sentinels or from chests found in Umbral Sands. It can be processed into ground obsidian at a grindstone.

It can also be used to make Pristine Armoured Catfish Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. U

It can also be used to make Pristine Beltfish Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. It can also be used to make Pristine Desert Sole Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. It can also be used to make Pristine Infernal Eel Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing.

pristine lobster.text: Pristine lobster is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into 3 roasted lobster starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt lobster at level 50. It can also be used to make a Pristine Lobster Trophy. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a fine net in Fellhollow. It is the pristine variant of a raw lobster.

pristine monkfish.text: Pristine monkfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire or grill into 3 monkfish fillets. It can also be used to make Pristine Monkfish Trophy. It can be gathered from net fishing spots with ideally a desert net in Umbral Sands. It is the pristine variant of a raw monkfish.

It can also be used to make Pristine Undead Bass Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Usin

pristine undead eel.text: Pristine undead eel is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into 3 Braised Undead Eel starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into 3 burnt undead eel at level 50. It can also be used to make Pristine Undead Eel Trophy. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a willow rod in Fellhollow at level 3 Fishing. Using lo

raw anchovies.text: Raw anchovies are a Power Level 3 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into seared anchovies starting at Cooking level 27, and not burnt into burnt anchovies at level 41. They can also be used to make anchovy bait. They can be gathered from net fishing spots with at least a wool net in Fractured Plains and Stormtouched Highlands.

raw armoured catfish.text: Raw armoured catfish is a Power Level 4 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into braised catfish starting at Cooking level 41, and not burnt into burnt catfish at level 50. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with ideally a maple rod in Dowdun Reach at level 3 Fishing. Using animated feather increases the chance of catching one. It is the n

raw beltfish.text: Raw beltfish is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into steamed beltfish. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using kalphite bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine beltfish.

raw desert sole.text: Raw desert sole is a Power Level 7 raw ingredient, which means it can be cooked at a campfire, grill, or with Infernal Rod into sun baked sole. It can be gathered from rod fishing spots with a yew rod in Umbral Sands at level 3 Fishing. Using monkfish bait increases the chance of catching one. It is the normal variant of a pristine desert sole.

To obtain these, players must either collect them from silver (or golden) reward packs or recycle silver bars in the jeweler's bench to make sheets of ten per bar.

smouldering draconic visage.text: The smouldering draconic visage is an award obtained from the Icthlarin's Little Helper quest. To gain this item, one must trade Fuzan's head to Icthlarin. This item can be used to craft the dragonfire shield.

tomato.text: Tomatoes are a Power Level 2 raw ingredient, which means they can be cooked at a campfire or grill into grilled tomatoes starting at Cooking level 12, and not burnt into burnt tomato at level 27. They can be gathered from Tomato (Farming) from tomato seeds.

undead draconic visage.text: The undead draconic visage is an award obtained from Death in exchange for Imaru's head, which is obtained by killing Imaru during or after the quest Withering Heights. It can be used to upgrade the anti-dragon shield into the dragoncurse shield.

Their primary use is to make lodestones, which serve as a teleport location that can be travelled to from any other lodestone the player has placed on the map. vine root.text: A vine root is an item that cannot be obtained in the game.

warped feathers.text: Warped feathers is a basic Agility material that can be found from Agility courses reward packs. Warped feathers can create the gyrhawk amulet along with coarse thread. However, players will need more feathers to charge the amulet to gain Agility experience whilst running, jumping, and dodging.

water rune.text: Water runes are runes imbued with water, found in certain mob drop packs like goblin packs and garou packs. They can be crafted at a rune altar at level 11 (or higher) Runecrafting or created by siphoning water anima vents.

wheat seeds.text: Wheat seeds are a type of Brynmoor seed, used in the Farming skill. Wheat seeds can be used to grow wheat in a farming plot. However, it is best to plant them in ash farming plot. adventurer's longbow.text: The adventurer's longbow is a power level 2 longbow which can be crafted using a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the vestige: a simple broken bow, found in a chest inside of Finn's Cave.

black greataxe.text: The black greataxe is a power level 6 two-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the bloodstained hilt, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments, or acquired from chest (dowdun reach). It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

black shield.text: The black shield is a power level 6 shield that is crafted with a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is unlocked after studying the battle-scarred black metal vestige, which can be purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. Unlike the black weapons, the shield cannot be found in chests in Dowdun Reach. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

black sword.text: The black sword is a one-handed power level 6 melee weapon. The recipe is unlocked after studying the shattered black blade vestige, which can be found in chests throughout Dowdun Reach or purchased from Postie Pete's Evil Emporium for 300 infernal fragments. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

blurite crossbow.text: The blurite crossbow is a power level 4 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned after studying the azure metal contraption found in a chest in northwest Fractured Plains. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.

bow of elidinis.text: The bow of Elidinis is a power level 7 masterwork longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is received as a reward for completing the Mapping The Sands II quest. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

coarse net.text: The coarse net is a power level 2 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. It is used to catch shrimp from net fishing spots found in Brynmoor.

crystal bow.text: The crystal bow is a power level 3 masterwork shortbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Heartstrings quest. It can then be crafted at a fletching bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

dorgeshuun crossbow.text: The dorgeshuun crossbow is a power level 5 crossbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is obtained from the quest Even More Restless Ghosts. It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.

draconic staff.text: The draconic staff is a power level 4 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is unlocked after studying the parts of a sinister-looking staff, which can be found in a chest on the western wall outside of Skeklac Kara, the dragonkin vault in Ashien's Watch. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

hunter stagbow.text: The hunter stagbow is a power level 4 longbow that can be crafted at a fletching bench. The recipe is learned by consuming a string of sinew, a vestige dropped by garou hunters with a 3/100 drop chance. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

keris.text: The keris is a power level 7 dagger. The recipe is learned from the corroded curved blade, found in the vault in southwest Umbral Sands, in the chest after the kalphite queen boss fight. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

necromancer's staff.text: The necromancer's staff is a power level 5 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe can be obtained by entering a spectral door and interacting with a dragonkin effigy in Vekchenven Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

pharaoh's sceptre.text: The pharaoh's sceptre is a power level 7 staff that can be crafted at a mystic forge. The recipe is learned from the Icthlarian fetish, the reward from the quest Contact!. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

It can be ascended at a mystic forge using ascension cores.

shadow sword.text: The shadow sword is a power level 5 greatsword created using a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is learned by consuming the shard of smoky glass, dropped from a zogre. It is required to complete Doric's Quest to receive the zombie axe. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

tzhaar-ket-om.text: TzHaar-ket-om is a power level 7 two-handed warhammer that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. ulv's longbow.text: Ulv's longbow is a power level 5 longbow that can be obtained (as well as its crafting recipe) as a reward from the Mirror, Mirror quest. It can then be crafted from a fletching bench. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

wolfbane dagger.text: The wolfbane dagger is a power level 5 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a blacksmith's bench. The recipe is acquired from a dragonkin effigy found in Vekchenven Kara, the dragonkin vault in central Fellhollow. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

wooden training sword.text: The wooden training sword is a power level 2 one-handed melee weapon that can be crafted at a crafting table. The recipe is learned by consuming the an educational blade, found in a chest atop the eastern roof of the church in Temple Woods. It can be ascended at the mystic forge using ascension cores.

wool net.text: The wool net is a power level 3 Fishing tool crafted at the crafting table. It is used to catch shrimp and anchovies from net fishing spots found in Brynmoor and Ghornfell.

nodes.name: Anima Vent
nodes.lead: Anima vents are Runecrafting nodes in Ashenfall coupled with the release of Dowdun Reach, where different types of vents can convert rune essence into different types of runes. By using the player's rune essence on these vents, and depending on the strength of the vent, players can acquire runes without a rune altar. These anima vents will produce sounds and runes specific to their type.
nodes.html:
Anima vents are Runecrafting nodes in Ashenfall coupled with the release of Dowdun Reach, where different types of vents can convert rune essence into different types of runes. By using the player's rune essence on these vents, and depending on the strength of the vent, players can acquire runes without a rune altar. These anima vents will produce sounds and runes specific to their type.

Akin to natural resource nodes (ex: Ore nodes, natural plant spawns), these vents will periodically recharge a certain amount per game cycle. These vents can be found throughout the continent and are not region-specific.

Players can detect the nearest anima vent near them by casting Summon Elemental Spirits, unlocked at level 19 Runecrafting.

Location

nodes.name: Ash Tree
nodes.lead: Ash trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and the most common type of tree found in most regions of Ashenfall (except for Bloodblight Swamp and Whispering Swamp); Forests in Bramblemead Valley are primarily composed of these trees. They can be felled with any logging axes using either chop or overhead chop. Cutting them down will grant 28 ash logs in total.
nodes.html:
Ash trees are Woodcutting resource nodes and the most common type of tree found in most regions of Ashenfall (except for Bloodblight Swamp and Whispering Swamp); Forests in Bramblemead Valley are primarily composed of these trees. They can be felled with any logging axes using either chop or overhead chop. Cutting them down will grant 28 ash logs in total.

Fully felling an ash tree grants 105 experience, excluding the stump.

Ash trees will regrow from stumps (or seeds through the Farming skill) after 3 in-game days (72 hours) after the tree has been felled. Cutting the stump will prevent the tree from growing again.

nodes.lead: Blightwood root are Woodcutting resource nodes located at the base of the large blightwood trees in the Bloodblight Swamp; players must have a iron logging axe or better to receive blightwood. Players can either chop these or cast Axtral Projection. Not every blightwood tree will have exposed roots, and there are a handful of roots that are not connected to any tree. Unlike other trees, these roots will only take one swing to clear with an iron logging axe, but only yield a small amount of logs per root. Blightwood roots respawn after three in-game days, as long as players do not place anything directly on the node's spawn.

regions.name: Brynmoor
regions.lead: Brynmoor is a power level 1 to 2 region in Ashenfall, ruled over by General Velgar, a green dragon. It is the first area in the game that players interact with. Brynmoor is located south of Ghornfell.
regions.history:
Brynmoor served as a sanctuary for the first settlers when they were brought to the continent by the god of balance, Guthix. The first settlers he brought with him were his followers, who were mostly human. This region had housed the Runecrafting Guild, the Adventurer's Guild, the village of Bramblemead, and the Keep of Blue Flames. It originally had iron deposits, but these were completely depleted due to the high demand for iron.

Guthixian settlement and the Schism

Guthix and his followers founded Bramblemead in the First Age. As the continent's anima worked on the settlers, some became Amalgamated, and the village began killing them, justifying it by denying that the afflicted were still human. The killing of the first of them, Mia Larsdottir, went unpunished, and vigilante mobs made the Amalgamated a routine target thereafter. The town blacksmith Glass Knife murdered more than a dozen of them with the agreement of many villagers, and her marriage to one of the village elders reduced her sentence to community service, setting a precedent for how crimes against the Amalgamated were treated.

The Wild Knights responded by entering the village after dark to rescue the persecuted. During these rescues they summoned crow, raven, and magpie spirits to distract the villagers, and their presence near the village became known as "dark tidings". Guthix left the continent in response to the killings, taking with him those followers untouched by the prejudice and charging the Wild Knights to protect the settlers and the wilderness from one another. Their captain took in the children the killings had orphaned.

The prejudice outlasted his departure. Amalgamated who joined the town guard continued to face it there, with villagers turning away rather than report crimes to them, and few remained in the service for long.

Saradominist rule

During the Third Age, while the God Wars consumed the wider world, Saradominist settlers reached the continent and established a camp on the clifftop above the valley. As the camp merged with the village below, the villagers, who considered themselves abandoned by their own god, proved receptive to its missionaries, and Bramblemead adopted Saradominist worship. The two faiths initially held equal standing on the village council, marked by copper pins for the druids and tin pins for the priests. Counsel was given by the Bronze Advisors who were meant to speak for order and balance in equal measure, but the Saradominist faction held the greater influence, and council policy increasingly favoured it until the Guthixian faith dwindled and the church stood alone.

Loyalty to the priesthood subsequently determined rank in the region, with noble titles going to the families that served the church most faithfully and the most obedient among them raised highest. The priests placed one family of minor officials in charge of the region, raising them to become the Dukes of Brynmoor. These same families supplied the church with its fighting order, the Paladins, drawn from the second, third, and fourth children of the nobility. The Paladins imposed the priesthood's discipline on Bramblemead and rebuilt it to the church's specifications. North-west of the village the Runecrafting Guild pursued the secrets of the runes Guthix had discovered on the continent, and to the east an Adventurer's Guild gathered champions to hunt the deadliest creatures of Ashenfall. On priestly advice, the region's ruler completed the shift by expelling the remaining Guthixian followers.

The Zamorakian cult known as the Children of Shadows originated in the region under this regime and drew in three apprentices from the Runecrafting Guild who had been passed over for promotion. The cult also placed an agent in the Duke's court as a household servant, tasked with engineering the establishment's downfall from within. In pursuit of power the three apprentices entered ancient dragonkin vaults, where they recovered a fragmentary forbidden text and followed its instructions. The text transformed them into creatures that drained the lives of those they encountered on returning to the village. The assembled Wild Knights were able to kill them only once sunlight rendered the creatures vulnerable.

The fall of Bramblemead

Blacksmiths travelling with the Saradominist priests brought iron-working to Ashenfall, and the tools and weapons it produced allowed villagers to enter the surrounding woods with far less risk. Bramblemead grew dependent on the metal and exhausted the region's deposits, disregarding the Wild Knights' objections to the rate of extraction. The resulting scarcity caused infighting and minor civil skirmishes, and White Knights from the Keep of Blue Flames were brought in to restore order. The exhausted deposits drove militias to prospect in Ghornfell, ending several years of peace during which villagers had sold hunting trinkets to the garou at well above their value. The garou regarded the incursions as a breach of their treaties, and grievances accumulated on both sides. The Dukes sought to expand their rule into Ghornfell and looked to the priests for a solution to what they called the region's garou problem. The Wild Knight Kessel killed a young garou prince during a skirmish with garou hunters, after which the Human-Garou War began. Brynmoor's blacksmiths armed the war effort with iron swords, consuming what supplies the village had left.

After the war ended, assassins calling themselves the Glass Knives, in reference to the earlier murderer, killed a number of Wild Knights. Corruption pervaded the village's final years, with nobles taking disproportionate shares of the region's wealth and the priesthood permitting this in exchange for payment. In response, a highwaywoman known as the Nightingale robbed caravans and tax collectors bound for the castle and distributed the proceeds among the villagers, who protected her identity. The nobility, wanting her erased from public memory rather than merely captured, hired the assassin Moragrin to track her down and kill her. Growing unrest forced many of the Amalgamated to leave for Fellhollow, where they encountered less hostility.

The region fell at the close of the age to the Dragon Rebellion, in which General Velgar served the Dragon Queen, Kuldra. He orchestrated the destruction of the Keep of Blue Flames, Bramblemead Village, and the Saradominist presence on Ashenfall. His forces killed villagers, priests, and soldiers indiscriminately, wiping out the region's human population.
regions.geography:
Brynmoor is comprised of three subregions: Temple Woods, Bramblemead Valley, and the Whispering Swamp.

Temple Woods

The Temple Woods is located on the cliffs overlooking the rest of Brynmoor, dominated by the Temple of Saradomin. The temple itself remains preserved due to a faint aura of priestly magic that repels the more monstrous creatures of the wilds. It serves as a sanctuary in the region. To the north-west of the temple stands an old, haunted windmill.

Bramblemead Valley

Bramblemead Valley was once the heart of human activity in the region. It contains the ruins of Bramblemead. Several key structures still stand, including the Keep of Blue Flames. The valley was also home to a great Runecrafting Guild, and an Adventurer's Guild, located to the east.

Whispering Swamp

The Whispering Swamp forms the northern border of Brynmoor and separates it from Ghornfell. The swamp is littered with the sunken remnants of the Human-Garou War, which neither side could fight effectively in the muddy water. The swamp is rich with resources for crafting, including rare herbs and ore deposits found within its caves. The area is patrolled by goblins and watched closely by the garou from the north. An ancient horror roams the swamp at night.

regions.history:
Garou settlement

The garou were not native to Ashenfall. Their homeworld was Antumnos, where the moon goddess Lougrim arrived as an outsider and was hunted as prey. She overpowered her hunters, travelled to the garou capital of Magrawn, and defeated every reigning clan king in a single battle to take the mantle of High Queen. She brought her people to Ashenfall some time afterwards, and they settled Ghornfell. Their kings preserved a link to the old world through the tokens they wore, each holding a single pebble taken from Antumnos and passing from monarch to monarch. Those kings held their seats by the rite of challenge, and a leader who declined a challenge was judged unfit to rule.

The garou shared the region with the dragonkin. Brakka held land in the Fractured Plains, and he took garou as slaves to raise a tower there. Rasthin had granted him mastery over the earth, and he used that power alongside their labour to build a monument to himself.

Under garou custom, humans crossing their land were held to have consented to the hunt by trespassing, and the killings continued until a treaty was made with Lougrim that closed garou territory to the practice. That agreement held for several years, and in that time the garou of Ghornfell traded with the villagers of Bramblemead, a settlement in the neighbouring region of Brynmoor.

The war with Brynmoor

The agreement held until Bramblemead exhausted Brynmoor's iron deposits and sent militias north into Ghornfell to prospect for more. The garou watched them fell woodland as they searched and treated the incursions as a breach of the treaty. The garou found these militias harder to kill than earlier travellers, and their attacks became skirmishes rather than slaughters.

What the garou faced changed when Bandos offered the villagers a solution to the conflict, and the Saradominist priests agreed terms with his emissaries under which they would receive the mines of Ghornfell and Bandos would claim Lougrim's head. The garou defences broke under the ogres he brought with him. They then held their lines against goblins sent in continuous waves from fortified positions, killing them by the dozen while the replacements outnumbered them. Their two enemies fought for separate reasons. The Saradominist priesthood held Lougrim to be a false goddess whose followers had to be destroyed. Lougrim told her people that Bandos pursued them over a slight they had inflicted on him long before, on a world far from Ashenfall. Garou armour that had held against bronze failed when the humans introduced iron, and the militias razed their settlements and killed whole families. The garou held that advance at King's Pass, the route from the Whispering Swamp into Ghornfell, for months. however casualties kept mounting.

Lougrim answered by giving herself into the service of the dragonkin Cabal, and their dragons entered the war on the garou side. The garou gained the titan wyrms the dragonkin Lacrussa had bred, which had served as the heaviest units the dragonkin fielded. By 4213 the garou had been driven back to the point of defeat, and these new allies turned the war around.

During the war, a patrol of garou cubs hunting the kill that would mark their passage into adulthood ambushed the hunter Ulv, a close friend of the necromancer Ravanna. She answered his death by drawing on the souls of slain garou to raise a storm over the Stormtouched Highlands, and the garou living beneath it have been struck by its lightning ever since. Lacrussa's titan wyrms died in that storm, and their bones remain scattered across the Highlands.

Garou who wanted no part in the fighting withdrew to the eastern plains, where they sowed wheat and barley and settled there for the duration of the war.

Velgar's ascendancy

With the war turning, Bandos left the garou lines and took the fight to the dragons himself. He discarded his wards and armour and challenged the dragon Velgar to single combat at the tower in the Fractured Plains, where Velgar's hide turned the axe aside and his poisonous breath drained the god's strength until he withdrew from Ashenfall entirely. Following the victory, Velgar spilled his own blood across the wheat fields to the east, and the crops the garou had sown there collapsed into venom.

The goblins of Ashenfall read Bandos's defeat as proof that the dragon outranked their god, and they took Velgar as his replacement. They have held to that faith since, living longer under him than they did under Bandos. The garou gained a truce from the withdrawal, agreed on terms that each side keep to its own territory, and it held for decades.

Kuldra's reign

The truce ended when the dragon queen Kuldra devoured Lougrim and claimed the throne. Garou tradition records the succession as a challenge fought and won on equal terms, in keeping with the rite by which their own kings ruled. A Moon Garou scroll recovered in the Umbral Sands contradicts that account, holding that Lougrim had spent her power shielding villages from dragonfire and that Kuldra killed her without issuing a challenge at all. Most of the garou submitted to the new queen regardless, and those who refused left Ghornfell to become the Moon Garou. Their own account holds that Kuldra pressed the garou who stayed into wars they had no part in and trained their young as killers.

Her rule also changed garou hunting practice. Lougrim had taught her people to kill cleanly and had refused them poison on the grounds that it cheapened the hunt, and Kuldra instructed them to use every tool available instead. The druids, once held to tradition and to a narrow choice of prey, adopted harsher methods under her. She set humans as the standing quarry, and the thanes enforced that order in her name.

Kuldra afterwards killed Brakka at his own tower and took his mastery of the earth, granting it to Velgar, who claimed the tower as his lair and holds it still. From it he destroyed Blue Flame Keep, the Saradominist presence on the continent, and Bramblemead itself, the village his region had once traded with.

The garou of Ghornfell serve Kuldra in the present day while keeping the rites Lougrim taught them. Her priests still carry the moon as their symbol and continue to mourn Lougrim.
regions.geography:
Ghornfell is divided into three subregions, each with a distinct environment.

Fractured Plains

The Fractured Plains are the hunting grounds of the resident garou. Unstable anima turns the local plants the colours of dragonfire, and Brakka's ruined tower stands at the centre of the region as Velgar's lair. A crystal on the mesa carries a mournful sound on the wind.

Stormtouched Highlands

Ravanna's storm rages over the Highlands, and its lightning strikes those who travel the ground below. The bones of the titan wyrms lie across the region, and the garou camp beneath their ribs. A stone monument to a fallen garou king overlooks the area.

Bloodblight Swamp

Bloodblight Swamp grew wheat and barley before Velgar's blood poisoned it. The water and the air both carry the toxin, and the garou living there have grown resistant to it at the cost of their tempers.
